question: U1700 的每个关键引脚分别连接到哪个网络？
reference_answer: U1700 的 VIN_B0_1、VIN_B1_1、VANA、VIN_B0_2、VIN_B1_2 接 VCC3V3，FB_B0 接 VCC1V1，FB_B1 接 VCC1V8，VOUT_BST 接 VCC50，EN1 接 MCU_5V_EN。
response:
根据电路网表资料（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF），**U1700 为 TI 的 LP87702-Q1 电源管理芯片（PMIC）**，物料号 20200424007 / LP87702RRHBRQ1，封装 pqfn50p5x5x90-32（QFN 5×5 mm，32 引脚）。其各引脚与网络的连接关系如下：

## U1700（LP87702-Q1）引脚连接表

### 1. 电源输入类引脚

| 引脚 | 连接网络 |
|---|---|
| VIN_B0_1 | VCC3V3 |
| VIN_B0_2 | VCC3V3 |
| VIN_B1_1 | VCC3V3 |
| VIN_B1_2 | VCC3V3 |
| VANA | VCC3V3 |

### 2. Buck B0 通道（输出 VCC1V1）

| 引脚 | 连接网络 |
|---|---|
| SW_B0_1 | N19935443 |
| SW_B0_2 | N19935443 |
| FB_B0 | VCC1V1 |
| PGND_B0_1 | GND |
| PGND_B0_2 | GND |

### 3. Buck B1 通道（输出 VCC1V8）

| 引脚 | 连接网络 |
|---|---|
| SW_B1_1 | N19935668 |
| SW_B1_2 | N19935668 |
| FB_B1 | VCC1V8 |
| PGND_B1_1 | GND |
| PGND_B1_2 | GND |

### 4. Boost/BST 通道（输出 VCC50，即 5V）

| 引脚 | 连接网络 |
|---|---|
| SW_BST | N19935658 |
| VOUT_BST | VCC50 |
| PGND_BST | GND |

### 5. 控制与接口类引脚

| 引脚 | 连接网络 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| EN1 | MCU_5V_EN | 使能控制 |
| SDA (EN3) | MCU_SDA_P15.5 | I2C 数据线 |
| SCL (EN2) | MCU_SCL_P15.4 | I2C 时钟线 |
| nINT | MCU_nINT_PMIC_P12.1 | 中断输出至 MCU |
| NRST | N19935946 | 复位 |
| CLKIN (GPO2) | MCU_WD_INH | 看门狗抑制信号 |
| WDI | MCU_WDI_P13.3 | 看门狗喂狗输入 |
| WD_RESET | TC367_RESET_N | 看门狗复位输出（接 MCU 复位） |
| PG1 (GPO1) | N19936014 | Power Good / GPO |
| PG0 | NC（源文件未声明网络连接） | 悬空 |
| GPO0 | NC（源文件未声明网络连接） | 悬空 |
| VMON1 | NC（源文件未声明网络连接） | 电压监测，悬空 |
| VMON2 | NC（源文件未声明网络连接） | 电压监测，悬空 |

### 6. 接地类引脚

| 引脚 | 连接网络 |
|---|---|
| PAD（散热焊盘） | GND |
| AGND | GND |

## 小结

- **供电**：U1700 由 VCC3V3 供电（VIN_B0/VIN_B1/VANA 均接 VCC3V3）；
- **三路输出**：Buck B0 反馈 FB_B0 接 VCC1V1（输出 1.1V）、Buck B1 反馈 FB_B1 接 VCC1V8（输出 1.8V）、BST 通道输出 VOUT_BST 接 VCC50（5V）；
- **与 MCU 的交互**：通过 I2C（MCU_SDA_P15.5 / MCU_SCL_P15.4）配置，nINT 上报中断，并集成看门狗功能（WDI 喂狗、WD_RESET 输出 TC367_RESET_N、CLKIN 接 MCU_WD_INH）；
- **使能**：EN1 由 MCU_5V_EN 控制，即该 PMIC 的 5V 输出（VCC50）由 MCU 使能；
- **悬空引脚**：PG0、GPO0、VMON1、VMON2 在源文件中未声明网络连接（NC）。

HM IDF01/F07/F25/F28/F31
模块功能 Module FunctionADAS产品支持KL15唤醒、CAN唤醒（平台预留）和以太网唤醒（平台预留）三种唤醒方式，当唤醒信号有效时直接使能一级电源，MCU开始工作并启动ADAS产品，并且MCU可以通过MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0信号辅助使能一级电源，实现off delay功能。 ADAS products support KL15 wake up, CAN wake up（Platform reservation），ETH wake up（Platform reservation）, three wake up modes. When the wake up signal is effective, the first-level power supply will be directly enabled. MCU starts to work and start the ADAS product, and the MCU can enable the first-level power supply through the MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0 signal assist to achieve the off delay function.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL15唤醒 KL15 Wake Up KL15分成两路信号： The KL15 signal divides into two signals: 一路经过防反二极管和分压电阻后用于使能一级电源LN10046，当KL15为逻辑高时有效，一级电源开始工作。并且MCU得电启动后会使能MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0引脚，通过防反接二极管辅助使能一级电源并在唤醒源掉电后实现OFF DELAY功能，确保MCU完成所有必要任务之后ADAS产品进入休眠。 One way passes through an anti-reverse diode and two divider resistors , used to enable the EN pin of the primary power supply LN10046, effective when the KL15 is logically high, the primary power supply starts working. The MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0 pin will be enabled after the MCU is powered on, and the primary power supply will be enabled through the anti-reverse diode assist, and the function of OFF DELAY will be performed after the wake source is powered off to ensure that the ADAS product will enter hibernation after the MCU completes all necessary tasks. 另一路通过防反接二极管和100K,1%、10K,1%分压电路，用于MCU的ADC采样进行是否有效判断。 用到的引脚网络是WKUP_ACQ，对应MCU的AN0引脚。 The other way through the anti-reverse diode and 100K,1%, 20K,1% voltage divider circuit, used for MCU ADC sampling to determine whether effective. The pin network used is WKUP_ACQ, which corresponds to the AN0 pin of the MCU. CAN特定帧唤醒 ADAS平台支持特定报文的CAN唤醒功能，当唤醒信号有效时会直接使能一级电源的使能信号，系统开始唤醒，MCU工作并启动整个ADAS产品工作。 CAN通讯接口，TCAN1145配置时支持CAN特定报文唤醒，TCAN1145的VBAT引脚接至UB_PR引脚，INH引脚通过分压和防反电路接至一级电源使能引脚，当CAN总线接收到唤醒报文时INH引脚为逻辑高，会使能一级电源，产品开始工作。INH信号通过一个防范二极管在通过100K和10K电阻分压后用MCU的AN11引脚采样。 2.CAN0 bus wake up The ADAS platform reserves the CAN wake-up function to support specific messages. When the wake-up signal is effective, the enable signal of the first-level power supply will be directly enabled, the system will start to wake up, and the MCU will work and start the entire ADAS product. CAN communication interface, TCAN1145 supports CAN specific message wake-up when configured, the VBAT pin of TCAN1145 is connected to UB_PR pin, The INH pin is connected to the primary power enable pin through the voltage divider and anti-reverse circuit. When the CAN bus receives the wake-up message, the INH pin is logically high, which will enable the primary power and the product will start to work. The INH signal is sampled with the AN11 pin of the MCU via a guard diode after voltage splitting through 100K and 33K resistors. 3.ETH报文唤醒 ADAS产品唤醒支持ETH报文唤醒，当唤醒信号有效时会直接使能一级电源的使能信号，系统开始唤醒，MCU工作并启动整个ADAS产品工作。ETH PHY DP83TC812R的VSLEEP引脚接至常电，INH引脚通过分压和防反电路接至一级电源使能引脚，当以太网接收到唤醒报文时INH引脚为逻辑高，会使能一级电源，产品开始工作。 3.Flexray specific packet wakeup The wakeup of ADAS products supports the wakeup of ETH message. When the wakeup signal is effective, the enable signal of the primary power supply will be directly enabled, and the system will start to wake up, and the MCU will work and start the whole ADAS product. The VSLEEP pin of the PHY DP83TC812R is connected to the Constant Power Supply, and the INH pin is connected to the primary power enable pin through the voltage divider and anti-reverse circuit. When the ETH bus receives the wake-up message, the INH pin is logically high, and the primary power is enabled and the product starts to work. 4.自保持唤醒 MCU_WKUP_HOLD 当CAN总线唤醒报文中断后，INH引脚电平会无效（逻辑低），此时MCU会通过MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0引脚进入OFF DELAY功能自保持唤醒一段时间，确保MCU完成所有必要任务之后ADAS产品进入休眠。 4. Self keeping wake up When the CAN bus wake-up frame is interrupted, the INH pin level will be invalid (low logic), and the MCU will enter the OFF DELAY function through the MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0 pin to keep awake for a period of time to ensure that the ADAS product will enter hibernation after the MCU completes all necessary tasks.

HM IDF01/F07/F25/F28/F31
模块功能 Module FunctionADAS产品支持KL15唤醒、CAN唤醒（平台预留）和以太网唤醒（平台预留）三种唤醒方式，当唤醒信号有效时直接使能一级电源，MCU开始工作并启动ADAS产品，并且MCU可以通过MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0信号辅助使能一级电源，实现off delay功能。 ADAS products support KL15 wake up, CAN wake up（Platform reservation），ETH wake up（Platform reservation）, three wake up modes. When the wake up signal is effective, the first-level power supply will be directly enabled. MCU starts to work and start the ADAS product, and the MCU can enable the first-level power supply through the MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0 signal assist to achieve the off delay function.

模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. VCC3V3_MCU to VCC1V25_MCU(ASILB) 3V3转1V25_MCU是使用MCU内置控制器进行控制的BUCK电源，用于MCU的核供电，功能安全需求达到ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 3V3 to 1V25_MCU is a BUCK power supply controlled by MCU built-in controller, which is used for MCU nuclear power supply. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. VCC3V3 to VCC0V75(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC0V75应用于EQ6的内核供电，要求输出电流能力大，现选型TI的电源方案TPS62872。用MCU的P22.0引脚使能芯片，用MCU_SDA_P15.5，MCU_SCL_P15.4引脚I2C通信来设置输出电压和通信。 VCC3V3 to VCC0V75 is applied to the core power supply of EQ6, which requires large output current capacity. The power supply scheme TPS62872 of TI is selected. P22.0 pin of MCU is used to enable the chip, and MCU_SDA_P15.5, MCU_SCL_P15.4 pin I2C communication is used to set the output voltage and communication. VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR(QM(B)) VCC3V3转0V75_MIPI_DDR用于EQ6的IO口供电，现使用矽力杰的SA23002进行设计。用MCU的P22.1引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR for EQ6 IO port power supply, Silergy’s SA23002 is designed. The P22.1 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3转VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50(QM(B)) VCC1V8用于EQ6、CAM、DDR、FLASH供电，VCC1V1用于EQ6、DDR供电，VCC50用于CAN收发器供电，现选择LP87702 PMIC方案。用MCU的P15.3引脚使能该芯片的5V输出，用MCU_SCL_P15.4，MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C通信来设置1.8V和1.1V输出电压和使能。 VCC1V8 is used for EQ6, CAM, DDR, FLASH power supply, VCC1V1 is used for EQ6, DDR power supply, VCC50 is used for CAN transceiver power supply, LP87702 PMIC scheme is selected. P15.3 pin of MCU is used to enable 5V output of the chip, and MCU_SCL_P15.4, MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C communication is used to set 1.8V and 1.1V output voltage and enable it. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC3V3_EQ用于EQ6的IO和摄像头供电，现使用负载开关进行设计。用MCU的P20.3引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ for EQ6’s IO and camera power supply, now using the load switch is designed. .The P20.3 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_ETH(QM) 3V3转3V3_ETH用于ETH供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P21.0引脚使能该芯片。 3V3 to 3V3_ETH for ETH power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P21.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ(QM(B)) VCC1V8转VCC1V8_EQ用于EQ供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P20.0引脚使能该芯片。 VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ for EQ power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P20.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip.

HM IDF02/F03/F04/F28
模块功能 Module FunctionEYEQ6-L最小系统组成：外部30MHz晶体给EYEQ6-L提供基本时钟输入，外部20MHz有源晶振提供监控时钟，外扩OSPI接口的2Gb NAND FLASH存储程序，外扩1GB的LPDDR4运存。NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_SPI进行电平转换，用于MCU读写NAND FLASH。 EYEQ6-L minimum system components: an external 30MHz crystal provides the basic clock input for EYEQ6-L, an external 20MHz active crystal provides the monitoring clock, an external 2GbNAND FLASH memory program for OSPI interface, and an external 1GB LPDDR4 operation memory. NXB0104 is used for level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8-SPI of NAND FLASH for MCU to read and write NAND FLASH.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solution 1、处理器 根据ADAS产品需求图像处理SOC功能安全需要达到ASIL-B，经综合评估选择Mobileye产品EYEQ6-L，最高功能安全可达到ASIL-B，接口资源丰富。 1.Processor According to the requirements of ADAS products, the functional safety of image processing SOC needs to reach ASIL-B. After comprehensive evaluation, Mobileye product EYEQ6-L is selected, and the highest functional safety can reach ASIL-B with abundant interface resources. + 2、时钟 硬件选型30MHz晶振给EYEQ6-L提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。外部20MHz有源晶振作为内部监控时钟。 2.Clock The 30MHz crystal provides clock input to the EYEQ6-L, and its internal PLL circuit completes frequency multiplication and frequency division for the EyeQ6-L core and each module. The external 20MHz active crystal is energized as an internal monitoring clock. 3、DDR EYEQ6在外扩的DDR中运行程序和存储临时数据，其DDR控制器可支持32bits位宽的LPDDR4 SDRAM，最大读写速率4266 Mb/s/pin 。本设计中选用1片32bit的LPDDR4 SDRAM，型号为车规级器件K4F8E3S4HD-GHCL02V，以充分利用数据带宽，保证EYEQ6的处理速度，LPDDR4工作环境温度为-40℃~105℃，单片总容量1GB。 3.DDR EYEQ6 runs programs and stores temporary data in the extended DDR. Its DDR controller supports LPDDR4 SDRAM with 32bits wide and a maximum read/write rate of 4266Mb/s/pin. In this design, a 32bit LPDDR4 SDRAM is selected, the model is car grade device K4F8E3S4HD-GHCLO2V, in order to make full use of the data bandwidth and ensure the processing speed of EYEQ6. The working environment temperature of LPDDR4 is -40℃-105℃, and the total capacity of a single chip is 1GB. 4、NAND FLASH 选择ME推荐的WinBond公司产品W35N02JWTBKF，容量2Gb，FLASH支持CRC安全机制。 NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_ SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_ SPI进行电平转换，通过MCU_SPI1_CS片选电平转换芯片，实现MCU对NAND FLASH的读写操作，转换芯片在本应用场景下支持最大传输速率80Mbps。 NAND FLASH Choose the WinBond company product W35N02JWTBKF recommended by ME, with a capacity of 2Gb and FLASH supporting CRC security mechanism. NXB0104 is used for the level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8_SPI of NAND FLASH. The level conversion chip is selected by MCU_SPI1_CS chip to realize the reading and writing operation of MCU to NAND FLASH. The converter chip supports a maximum transmission rate of 80Mbps in this application scenario. 5、电源和复位 EYEQ6-L需要6路电源：VCC3V3_EQ、VCC0V75、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC1V8_EQ，其中VCC0V75用于给内核供电。复位信号由MCU通过P02.4口进行控制。 Power and reset EYEQ6-L requires six power sources: VCC3V3-EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V8_EQ, where VCCOV75 is used to power the core. The reset signal is controlled by the MCU through the P02.4 pin.

模块方案 Module solutionEQ6系统电源电压采样 系统需求需要MCU对LP87702、TPS62872、SA23002、TPS22918和摄像头端的电压VCC3V3_EQ，VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC3V3_CAM，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM进行ADC采样和异常监控。其中VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM电压范围未超量程对电压直接采样。VCC3V3_EQ和VCC3V3_CAM经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_EQ用AN2引脚采样，VCC1V8用AN3引脚采样，VCC1V1用AN4引脚采样，VCC1V8_EQ用AN5引脚采样，VCC3V3_CAM用AN12引脚采样，VCC1V1_CAM用AN13引脚采样，VCC1V8_CAM用AN14引脚采样，VCC0V75_MIPI_DDR用AN18引脚采样，VCC0V75用AN19引脚采样。 EQ6 system power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the voltages VCC3V3_EQ, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC3V3_CAM, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM for the LP87702, TPS62872, SA23002, TPS22918, and camera-side devices. Among these voltages, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM have voltage ranges within the measurement range and are directly sampled. VCC3V3_EQ and VCC3V3_CAM are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_EQ is sampled using AN2, VCC1V8 using AN3, VCC1V1 using AN4, VCC1V8_EQ using AN5, VCC3V3_CAM using AN12, VCC1V1_CAM using AN13, VCC_1V8_CAM using AN14, 0V75_MIPI_DDR using AN18, and VCC0V75 using AN19. Its DDR controller supports LPDDR4 SDRAM with 32bits wide and a maximum read/write rate of 4266Mb/s/pin. In this design, a 32bit LPDDR4 SDRAM is selected, the model is car grade device K4F8E3S4HD-GHCLO2V, in order to make full use of the data bandwidth and ensure the processing speed of EYEQ6. The working environment temperature of LPDDR4 is -40℃-105℃, and the total capacity of a single chip is 1GB. 4、NAND FLASH 选择ME推荐的WinBond公司产品W35N02JWTBKF，容量2Gb，FLASH支持CRC安全机制。 NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_ SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_ SPI进行电平转换，通过MCU_SPI1_CS片选电平转换芯片，实现MCU对NAND FLASH的读写操作，转换芯片在本应用场景下支持最大传输速率80Mbps。 NAND FLASH Choose the WinBond company product W35N02JWTBKF recommended by ME, with a capacity of 2Gb and FLASH supporting CRC security mechanism. NXB0104 is used for the level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8_SPI of NAND FLASH. The level conversion chip is selected by MCU_SPI1_CS chip to realize the reading and writing operation of MCU to NAND FLASH. The converter chip supports a maximum transmission rate of 80Mbps in this application scenario. 5、电源和复位 EYEQ6-L需要6路电源：VCC3V3_EQ、VCC0V75、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC1V8_EQ，其中VCC0V75用于给内核供电。复位信号由MCU通过P02.4口进行控制。 Power and reset EYEQ6-L requires six power sources: VCC3V3-EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V8_EQ, where VCCOV75 is used to power the core. The reset signal is controlled by the MCU through the P02.4 pin.

模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionEQ6温度采样 EQ6-L内部内置了两个温度传感器，并通过外部SPI接口实时发送给MCU，硬件设计可以支持MCU对EQ6结温的监控。 1, EQ6 temperature sampling EQ6-l has two internal temperature sensors, which are sent to the MCU in real time through the external SPI interface. The hardware design can support the MCU to monitor the junction temperature of EQ6. NTC温度采样 硬件设计使用温敏电阻NTC（NCU15XH103F6SRC）采集EQ6/LPDDR4周边环境温度，并通过MCU进行ADC采样和实时监控。NTC温度监控范围：-40~150℃，监控精度±3℃@-40~150℃，MCU的ADC为10bit，即1024个量阶，使得监测精度可以达到3.2mV，电压采集范围0-3.3V。用MCU的AN7引脚采样。 2.NTC temperature sampling In hardware design, the temperature sensor NTC (NCU15XH103F6SRC) is used to collect the ambient temperature of EQ6/LPDDR4, and the ADC sampling and real-time monitoring are carried out by MCU. NTC temperature monitoring range: -40-150℃, monitoring accuracy ±3℃@-40-150℃, MCU ADC is 10bit, that is, 1024 quantity order, so that the monitoring accuracy can reach 3.2mV, voltage acquisition range 0-3.3V. The AN7 pin of the MCU is used for sampling. CAM温度采样 CAM的IMX-728内置了两个温度传感器，温度测量范围是：-40~125℃，温度监控精度为±5℃@-40~125℃。EYEQ6可以通过I2C接口（EQ6L的I2C_0_SCLK和I2C_0_SDA引脚）实时读取IMX-728的工作温度，并进行状态监控和异常诊断。 3.CAM temperature sampling CAM IMX-728 built-in two temperature sensors, temperature measurement range is: -40~125℃, temperature monitoring accuracy of ±5℃@-40~125℃. EYEQ6 can read the operating temperature of the IMX-728 in real time through the I2C interface (I2C_0_SCLK and I2C_0_SDA pins of EQ6L), and perform condition monitoring and anomaly diagnosis.

question: 给板子供电的主 PMIC 是哪颗？它输出哪些电压，软件如何配置？
reference_answer: 主 PMIC 是 U1700，即 LP87702-Q1，输入 VCC3V3，输出包括 VCC1V1、VCC1V8 和 VCC50；软件配置依据 HSI 7.2 节 LP87702 配置说明，通过 I²C 相关信号配置。
response:
根据知识库中的 HSI 硬件规格文档和电路网表资料，回答如下：

## 一、主 PMIC 型号：TI LP87702

资料中明确记载（HSI 文档 F13/POWER 模块）：

> "VCC50 用于 CAN 收发器供电，**现选择 LP87702 PMIC 方案**……采用 LP87702 芯片，将 VCC3V3 转换为 VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50。"

电路网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）也与之吻合：电源拓扑中 `VCC3V3 → U1700 → VCC50`，且 U1700 的 nINT 引脚接到网络 `MCU_nINT_PMIC_P12.1`（即 MCU 的 P12.1），可确认 **U1700 即该颗 PMIC（LP87702）**。

## 二、供电链路与输出电压

整板供电架构为：

```
KL30 (车载电池 12V, 9~16V)
  → EMI 电路（串联ESD电容 + 双向TVS，ASIL-B 防护）
  → 一级 DC-DC：KL30 → VCC3V3（ASIL-B，给 MCU 提供 VCC3V3_MCU）
  → LP87702 (U1700)：VCC3V3 → VCC1V8 / VCC1V1 / VCC50
```

LP87702 的三路输出及用途：

| 输出电压 | 供电对象 |
|---|---|
| **VCC1V8** | EQ6（EYEQ6-L SoC）、Camera（IMX-728）、DDR、FLASH |
| **VCC1V1** | EQ6、DDR |
| **VCC50 (5V)** | CAN 收发器 |

## 三、软件如何配置（MCU 控制接口）

HSI 文档中给出了明确的 MCU 引脚分配和控制方式：

| 控制项 | MCU 引脚 | 方式 |
|---|---|---|
| VCC50（5V）使能/关断 | **P15.3**（GPIO） | GPIO 直接控制 |
| VCC1V8 / VCC1V1 输出电压设置与使能/关断 | **P15.4 (SCL) / P15.5 (SDA)** | **I2C 通信**配置 |
| PMIC 复位 | **P12.1** | GPIO 复位 |
| PMIC 中断（辅助监控工作状态） | P12.1（nINT，预留） | 中断信号 |

补充要点：

1. **运行期寄存器配置**：HSI 文档"其他芯片配置"章节规定"LP87702 运行期间需要 MCU 通过 I2C 配置的寄存器"（Table 5-2 LP87702 Configuration），即软件需按该表在运行期间通过 I2C 写寄存器完成电压/使能配置。
2. **状态监控**：MCU 可通过 I2C 监控和管理 LP87702 的状态，并预留中断信号辅助监控。
3. **电压 ADC 采样监控**（功能安全 ASIL-B 要求）：MCU 对 LP87702 输出的 VCC1V8（AN3 引脚）、VCC1V1（AN4 引脚）等电源轨进行 ADC 采样和过欠压异常监控，阈值按 WCCA 计算结果设置。

## 四、证据范围与未尽事项

- 以上结论来自两份 HSI 文档（600608964_ADAS_HSI 系列）及 TCN2 电路网表，证据一致。
- **知识库中未检索到**：① 一级 DC-DC（KL30→VCC3V3）的具体芯片型号（文档仅描述其功能与 ASIL-B 要求）；② Table 5-2 中 LP87702 具体寄存器地址/取值和 I2C 从机地址。如需这些细节，建议查阅 HSI 文档原文对应表格或 LP87702 数据手册。

HM IDF01/F08/F09
模块功能 Module Function系统需求需要板内电源电压进行ADC采样和异常监控，要求功能安全达到ASIL-B等级，确保EQ6系统工作安全。 The system requirements require the on-board power supply voltage for ADC sampling and anomaly monitoring, and the functional safety is required to reach ASIL-B level to ensure the working safety of EQ6 system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionEQ6系统电源电压采样 系统需求需要MCU对LP87702、TPS62872、SA23002、TPS22918和摄像头端的电压VCC3V3_EQ，VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC3V3_CAM，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM进行ADC采样和异常监控。其中VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM电压范围未超量程对电压直接采样。VCC3V3_EQ和VCC3V3_CAM经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_EQ用AN2引脚采样，VCC1V8用AN3引脚采样，VCC1V1用AN4引脚采样，VCC1V8_EQ用AN5引脚采样，VCC3V3_CAM用AN12引脚采样，VCC1V1_CAM用AN13引脚采样，VCC1V8_CAM用AN14引脚采样，VCC0V75_MIPI_DDR用AN18引脚采样，VCC0V75用AN19引脚采样。 EQ6 system power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the voltages VCC3V3_EQ, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC3V3_CAM, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM for the LP87702, TPS62872, SA23002, TPS22918, and camera-side devices. Among these voltages, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM have voltage ranges within the measurement range and are directly sampled. VCC3V3_EQ and VCC3V3_CAM are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_EQ is sampled using AN2, VCC1V8 using AN3, VCC1V1 using AN4, VCC1V8_EQ using AN5, VCC3V3_CAM using AN12, VCC1V1_CAM using AN13, VCC_1V8_CAM using AN14, 0V75_MIPI_DDR using AN18, and VCC0V75 using AN19. CANÐ电源电压采样 系统需求MCU对LP87702、TPS22918的输出电压VCC3V3_ETH，VCC50进行ADC采样和异常监控，VCC3V3_ETH和VCC50经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_ETH用AN8引脚采样，VCC50用AN1引脚采样。 CANÐ power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the output voltages VCC3V3_ETH and VCC50 from the LP87702 and TPS22918. Both VCC3V3_ETH and VCC50 are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_ETH is sampled using AN8, and VCC50 is sampled using AN1.

Standby mode The device will automatically enter standby mode upon power-up only if*the PHY is configured in Master mode and set to managed mode. If the PHY operates in auto mode, it will automatically enter normal mode after power-on. 4. Sleep mode The PHY enters sleep mode when a sleep command is issued and the MDI bus is idle. In this mode, all PHY modules are disabled except for energy detection functionality. Note that all register configurations will be lost during sleep mode.

After comprehensive evaluation, Mobileye product EYEQ6-L is selected, and the highest functional safety can reach ASIL-B with abundant interface resources. + 2、时钟 硬件选型30MHz晶振给EYEQ6-L提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。外部20MHz有源晶振作为内部监控时钟。 2.Clock The 30MHz crystal provides clock input to the EYEQ6-L, and its internal PLL circuit completes frequency multiplication and frequency division for the EyeQ6-L core and each module. The external 20MHz active crystal is energized as an internal monitoring clock. 3、DDR EYEQ6在外扩的DDR中运行程序和存储临时数据，其DDR控制器可支持32bits位宽的LPDDR4 SDRAM，最大读写速率4266 Mb/s/pin 。本设计中选用1片32bit的LPDDR4 SDRAM，型号为车规级器件K4F8E3S4HD-GHCL02V，以充分利用数据带宽，保证EYEQ6的处理速度，LPDDR4工作环境温度为-40℃~105℃，单片总容量1GB。 3.DDR EYEQ6 runs programs and stores temporary data in the extended DDR. Its DDR controller supports LPDDR4 SDRAM with 32bits wide and a maximum read/write rate of 4266Mb/s/pin. In this design, a 32bit LPDDR4 SDRAM is selected, the model is car grade device K4F8E3S4HD-GHCLO2V, in order to make full use of the data bandwidth and ensure the processing speed of EYEQ6. The working environment temperature of LPDDR4 is -40℃-105℃, and the total capacity of a single chip is 1GB. 4、NAND FLASH 选择ME推荐的WinBond公司产品W35N02JWTBKF，容量2Gb，FLASH支持CRC安全机制。 NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_ SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_ SPI进行电平转换，通过MCU_SPI1_CS片选电平转换芯片，实现MCU对NAND FLASH的读写操作，转换芯片在本应用场景下支持最大传输速率80Mbps。 NAND FLASH Choose the WinBond company product W35N02JWTBKF recommended by ME, with a capacity of 2Gb and FLASH supporting CRC security mechanism. NXB0104 is used for the level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8_SPI of NAND FLASH. The level conversion chip is selected by MCU_SPI1_CS chip to realize the reading and writing operation of MCU to NAND FLASH. The converter chip supports a maximum transmission rate of 80Mbps in this application scenario. 5、电源和复位 EYEQ6-L需要6路电源：VCC3V3_EQ、VCC0V75、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC1V8_EQ，其中VCC0V75用于给内核供电。复位信号由MCU通过P02.4口进行控制。 Power and reset EYEQ6-L requires six power sources: VCC3V3-EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V8_EQ, where VCCOV75 is used to power the core. The reset signal is controlled by the MCU through the P02.4 pin.

根据知识库中的资料（ADAS HSI 硬件接口文档及电路网表），VCC0V75 电源的相关信息如下：

## 一、产生芯片

**VCC0V75 由 TI 的 TPS62872 电源芯片（DC-DC）产生**，对应硬件模块编号 **F14（POWER）**，功能安全需求等级为 **QM(B)**。

> 依据：HSI 文档 F14 模块描述："VCC3V3转VCC0V75应用于EQ6的内核供电，要求输出电流能力大，现选型TI的方案TPS62872"；模块清单中亦列明"F14 / POWER：TPS62872，VCC3V3电压输入，VCC0V75电压输出，EQ6L核电供电"。

电路网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）也印证了这一点：VCC0V75 网络连接至 U1800（TPS62872）的 VOSNS 反馈引脚，并输出到 EYEQ6-L（U400）的 **VDD_CORE1~VDD_CORE34** 全部内核电源引脚。

## 二、输入电源

- **输入：VCC3V3（3.3V）**，由系统一级 DC-DC（KL30 转 VCC3V3）提供；
- **输出：VCC0V75（0.75V）**，专门用于 **EQ6（EYEQ6-L）的内核（核电）供电**，选型时要求输出电流能力大。

⚠️ 注意区分：**VCC0V75_MIPI_DDR** 是另一路 0.75V 电源，由 **SA23002** 芯片产生（模块 F15），与 VCC0V75 不是同一颗芯片。

## 三、文档中的配置要求

1. **使能控制**：用 MCU 的 **P22.0 引脚**（网络名 MCU_VCC0V75_EN）使能 TPS62872 芯片（网表确认该网络连接 U900E.P22.0）。

2. **输出电压设置**：用 **MCU_SDA_P15.5、MCU_SCL_P15.4 引脚通过 I2C 通信**来设置输出电压和通信。

3. **上下电时序要求**：EQ6 系统的六路电源（VCC3V3_EQ、VCC1V8、VCC1V8_EQ、**VCC0V75**、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V1）需要**按照 EQ6 要求的时序进行上下电控制**——上电模式由 MCU 按时序控制各电源上电并将复位信号 EYEQ6_RESET_N 置高；下电模式按时序下电并将复位信号置低。

4. **电压采样与精度要求**：MCU 通过 ADC（引脚 W3/AN19，分辨率 10bit，网络 0V75_ACQ）采样 VCC0V75 电压：
   - 采样公式：U0V75_ACQ = 3.3 × ADC值 / 1024
   - 精度要求：**0V75±3%**（另一处表格写为 0.75V±3.3%）
   - 硬件滤波截止频率：≥121.7Hz
   - 硬件滤波时间：≤1.6ms

5. **功能安全关联**：F14（TPS62872 电源）与 F01（MCU，SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA，ASIL-B）及 F08（EQ 系统电源电压 ADC 采样滤波、分压电路，B(B)）存在功能安全关联。

**证据范围说明**：以上内容来自 HSI 硬件接口文档（600608964_ADAS_HSI 系列）和电路网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）。知识库中未检索到 TPS62872 的详细 datasheet 参数（如具体开关频率、电感选型、I2C 寄存器地址等），如需该层面的配置细节，建议查阅 TI 官方数据手册。

The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. 模块功能 Module FunctionEYEQ6-L最小系统组成：外部30MHz晶体给EYEQ6-L提供基本时钟输入，外部20MHz有源晶振提供监控时钟，外扩OSPI接口的2Gb NAND FLASH存储程序，外扩1GB的LPDDR4运存。NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_SPI进行电平转换，用于MCU读写NAND FLASH。 EYEQ6-L minimum system components: an external 30MHz crystal provides the basic clock input for EYEQ6-L, an external 20MHz active crystal provides the monitoring clock, an external 2GbNAND FLASH memory program for OSPI interface, and an external 1GB LPDDR4 operation memory. 模块方案 Module solution 1、处理器 根据ADAS产品需求图像处理SOC功能安全需要达到ASIL-B，经综合评估选择Mobileye产品EYEQ6-L，最高功能安全可达到ASIL-B，接口资源丰富。 1.Processor According to the requirements of ADAS products, the functional safety of image processing SOC needs to reach ASIL-B. After comprehensive evaluation, Mobileye product EYEQ6-L is selected, and the highest functional safety can reach ASIL-B with abundant interface resources. + 2、时钟 硬件选型30MHz晶振给EYEQ6-L提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。外部20MHz有源晶振作为内部监控时钟。 2.Clock The 30MHz crystal provides clock input to the EYEQ6-L, and its internal PLL circuit completes frequency multiplication and frequency division for the EyeQ6-L core and each module. The external 20MHz active crystal is energized as an internal monitoring clock. 3、DDR EYEQ6在外扩的DDR中运行程序和存储临时数据，其DDR控制器可支持32bits位宽的LPDDR4 SDRAM，最大读写速率4266 Mb/s/pin 。本设计中选用1片32bit的LPDDR4 SDRAM，型号为车规级器件K4F8E3S4HD-GHCL02V，以充分利用数据带宽，保证EYEQ6的处理速度，LPDDR4工作环境温度为-40℃~105℃，单片总容量1GB。 3.DDR EYEQ6 runs programs and stores temporary data in the extended DDR. Its DDR controller supports LPDDR4 SDRAM with 32bits wide and a maximum read/write rate of 4266Mb/s/pin. In this design, a 32bit LPDDR4 SDRAM is selected, the model is car grade device K4F8E3S4HD-GHCLO2V, in order to make full use of the data bandwidth and ensure the processing speed of EYEQ6. The working environment temperature of LPDDR4 is -40℃-105℃, and the total capacity of a single chip is 1GB. 4、NAND FLASH 选择ME推荐的WinBond公司产品W35N02JWTBKF，容量2Gb，FLASH支持CRC安全机制。 NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_ SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_ SPI进行电平转换，通过MCU_SPI1_CS片选电平转换芯片，实现MCU对NAND FLASH的读写操作，转换芯片在本应用场景下支持最大传输速率80Mbps。 NAND FLASH Choose the WinBond company product W35N02JWTBKF recommended by ME, with a capacity of 2Gb and FLASH supporting CRC security mechanism. NXB0104 is used for the level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8_SPI of NAND FLASH. The level conversion chip is selected by MCU_SPI1_CS chip to realize the reading and writing operation of MCU to NAND FLASH. The converter chip supports a maximum transmission rate of 80Mbps in this application scenario. 5、电源和复位 EYEQ6-L需要6路电源：VCC3V3_EQ、VCC0V75、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC1V8_EQ，其中VCC0V75用于给内核供电。复位信号由MCU通过P02.4口进行控制。 Power and reset EYEQ6-L requires six power sources: VCC3V3-EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V8_EQ, where VCCOV75 is used to power the core. The reset signal is controlled by the MCU through the P02.4 pin.

HM IDF24
运行模式 Operation Mode正常模式、复位模式，待机模式，断电模式，休眠模式 Normal mode, reset mode, standby mode, power off mode, sleep mode
模式定义 Definition of Operation mode1、 正常模式 模块上电，正常运行模式，以太网收发正常。MDIO可以访问，Link处于连接状态。 2、 复位模式 UV或Reset event时，PHY芯片将进行复位，在Reset期间将无法LINKUP，MDIO无法总线访问 待机模式 仅当PHY为MASTER且配置成管理模式时，上电自动进入待机模式。如果是自动模式，上电后自动进入正常模式。 4、 断电模式 当任何一个电源轨低于POR阈值（0.6V）时，PHY处于断电状态，所有数字IO都将保持高阻态。 休眠模式 当有休眠指令且MDI总线空闲时，将进入休眠模式，除了能量检测外，禁用所有PHY模块。在睡眠模式下，所有寄存器配置都会丢失。 Normal mode Power on，Normal Run mode, Ethernet transceiver is normal. MDIO is accessible and Link is in a connected state. Reset mode UV or Reset event, the PHY chip will Reset, during reset will not be able to LINKUPMDIO cannot bus access. Standby mode The device will automatically enter standby mode upon power-up only if*the PHY is configured in Master mode and set to managed mode. If the PHY operates in auto mode, it will automatically enter normal mode after power-on. 4. Sleep mode The PHY enters sleep mode when a sleep command is issued and the MDI bus is idle. In this mode, all PHY modules are disabled except for energy detection functionality. Note that all register configurations will be lost during sleep mode.

7.3.1Step-DownDC/DCConverters
7.3.1.1 Overview
The LP87702 includes two high-efficiency step-down DC/DC converters. The buck converters deliver 0.7-V to 3.36-V regulated voltage rails from 2.8-V to 5.5-V input-supply voltage. The converters are designed for flexibility; most of the functions are programmable, thus optimizing the converter operation for each application:
DvS support with programmable slew rate Automatic mode control based on the loading (PwM or PFM mode)· ForcedPWMmodeoption· Optional external clock input to minimize crosstalk Optional spread spectrum technique to reduce EMl Synchronousrectification Current mode loop with Pl compensator Soft start Programmable output voltage monitoring with maskable interrupt and selectable connection PG0 or PG1 Average output current sensing (for PFM entry and load current measurement)
 Some of the key parameters that can be programmed through the registers (with default values set by OTP bits):
Output voltage ·Forced PwM operation Switch current limit· Output voltage slewrate· Enable and disable delays with ENx pin control·
There are two modes of operation for the buck converters, depending on the output current required: pulse width modulation (PWM) and pulse-frequency modulation (PFM). The converter operates in PWM mode at high load currents of approximately 520 mA or higher. Lighter output current loads will cause the converter to automatically switch into PFM mode for reduced current consumption when forced PWM mode is disabled. The forced PWM mode can be selected to maintain fixed switching frequency at all load currents. When buck is disabled, buck output is isolated from the input voltage rail. Output has an optional pulldown resistor.

For the gated mode of operation, the PGx behaves as follows:
 PGx is set to active or asserted state upon exiting the OTP configuration as an initial default state.
The PGx status is active or asserted during an 8o0-μs gated time period from the enable activation for each enabled rail, thereby gating-off the status indication.
The PGx state typically remains active or asserted for normal conditions during normal power-up sequencing and requestedvoltagechanges.
The PGx status could change to inactive or de-asserted after an 800-μs gated time period if any output voltage is outside of regulation range during an abnormal power-up sequencing and requested voltage changes.
Using the gated mode of operation could allow the PGx signal to initiate an immediate power shutdown
sequence if the PGx signal is wired-OR with signal connected to the EN input. This type of circuit configuration provides a smart PORz function for processor that eliminates the need for additional
components to generate PORz upon start-up and to monitor voltage levels of key voltage domains.
PGx signal is set inactive if the output voltage of a monitored buck or boost converter is invalid or the output voltage is not valid at 8o0 μs from the enable of the converter, which should be considered when selecting the BUCKx_SLEW_RATE setting. Keep the sum of the soft start time and slew rate controlled part of the voltage
ramp below 8o0 μs to avoid PGx triggering at start-up. In addition, the PGx is inactive when the invalid input voltage at VANA, VMON1, or VMON2 pin is detected.
Detected fault sets the corresponding fault bit in PGO_FAULT or in PG1_FAULT register. The detected fault must be cleared to continue the PGx monitoring. The over-voltage and thermal faults are cleared by writing 1 to the corresponding interrupt bits in INT_TOP_1 register. Converter, VMONx and VANA faults are cleared by writing 1 to the corresponding register bit in INT_BUCK, INT_BOOST, and INT_DIAG register, respectively. question: 3.3V 电源有没有过压保护，是如何实现的？
reference_answer: HSI 2.3.12 节说明 VCC3V3_MCU 存在 3V3 过压保护电路：当 VCC3V3 超过 4.03V 时，比较器输出关闭 NMOS 与 PMOS，切断 VCC3V3_SW；EDF 可补充网络与二极管或 TVS 拓扑，但不能据此断言未被文档直接描述的保护能力。
response:
**有的。** 根据知识库中的硬件软件接口文档（ADAS HSI，HM ID F18），3.3V 电源设计了专门的硬件过压保护电路（"3V3过压保护电路 / 3V3 overvoltage protection circuit"），具体如下：

## 一、3.3V 过压保护电路（核心保护，HM ID F18）

**设计背景**：AOU 要求 MCU 需在硬件外部增加过压保护电路，对 3V3_MCU 进行电压监控。

**实现方式**：采用「电压检测器件 + NMOS（Q1701）+ PMOS」组成的开关式保护电路，串接在 VCC3V3 与后级 VCC3V3_SW 之间，通过检测 3.3V 电压是否超过 **4.03V 阈值**来控制 MOS 管通断，切断后级供电。

**工作原理（三种状态）**：

| 工作状态 | 电压条件 | 电路行为 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 欠压/未上电 | VCC3V3 < 4.03V 且 < VGS 门限（Q1701） | 检测器件 cathode 引脚为高阻态，NMOS 关闭、PMOS 关闭，VCC3V3_SW 无电 |
| ② 正常工作 | 4.03V > VCC3V3 > VGS 门限（Q1701） | NMOS 打开、PMOS 打开，VCC3V3_SW 与 VCC3V3 直通，正常向后级供电 |
| ③ 过压保护 | VCC3V3 > 4.03V | cathode 引脚输出逻辑低（最高 1V），NMOS 关闭、PMOS 关闭，VCC3V3_SW 无电，**对后级负载起到过压保护作用** |

即：一旦 3.3V 电压超过 4.03V，保护电路立即关断串联 MOS 开关，使后级负载（VCC3V3_SW）完全断电，避免过压损坏。

## 二、配套的辅助保护与监控机制

1. **前级 KL30（UBD）入口保护**：KL30 供电口 EMI 电路中，在 UBD 网络增加两个串联 ESD 电容（靠近主连接器引脚布局）吸收外部 ESD 信号，后端增加**双向 TVS 管用于瞬态过压保护**（电路网表中对应 D1601，连接 UBD 与 GND），并加肖特基二极管防反接、Π 型滤波电路。3.3V 即由一级 DC-DC 芯片 **LN10046** 从 12V 转换输出。

2. **MCU ADC 采样监控（软件层）**：系统要求对板内电源电压进行 ADC 采样和异常监控（功能安全 ASIL-B）；软件按 WCCA 计算结果设置过欠压阈值。其中 VCC3V3_EQ、VCC3V3_CAM 等经两个 10K 1% 精度电阻分压后由 MCU ADC 采样（如 VCC3V3_CAM 用 AN12 引脚，精度要求 3.3V±5%）。当软件诊断到电源电压异常时，MCU 会关断 EQ 及其他负载的工作电源，确保功能安全。

**小结**：3.3V 电源的过压保护以**硬件保护电路为主**——通过 4.03V 电压检测阈值驱动 NMOS/PMOS 开关，过压时直接切断 VCC3V3_SW 对后级供电；同时辅以前级 TVS 瞬态过压钳位和 MCU ADC 电压采样监控（软件按过欠压阈值诊断并关断负载）形成多层防护。

**工作原理（三种状态）**：

| 工作状态 | 电压条件 | 电路行为 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 欠压/未上电 | VCC3V3 < 4.03V 且 < VGS 门限（Q1701） | 检测器件 cathode 引脚为高阻态，NMOS 关闭、PMOS 关闭，VCC3V3_SW 无电 |
| ② 正常工作 | 4.03V > VCC3V3 > VGS 门限（Q1701） | NMOS 打开、PMOS 打开，VCC3V3_SW 与 VCC3V3 直通，正常向后级供电 |
| ③ 过压保护 | VCC3V3 > 4.03V | cathode 引脚输出逻辑低（最高 1V），NMOS 关闭、PMOS 关闭，VCC3V3_SW 无电，**对后级负载起到过压保护作用** |

即：一旦 3.3V 电压超过 4.03V，保护电路立即关断串联 MOS 开关，使后级负载（VCC3V3_SW）完全断电，避免过压损坏。

## 二、配套的辅助保护与监控机制

1. **前级 KL30（UBD）入口保护**：KL30 供电口 EMI 电路中，在 UBD 网络增加两个串联 ESD 电容（靠近主连接器引脚布局）吸收外部 ESD 信号，后端增加**双向 TVS 管用于瞬态过压保护**（电路网表中对应 D1601，连接 UBD 与 GND），并加肖特基二极管防反接、Π 型滤波电路。3.3V 即由一级 DC-DC 芯片 **LN10046** 从 12V 转换输出。

2. **MCU ADC 采样监控（软件层）**：系统要求对板内电源电压进行 ADC 采样和异常监控（功能安全 ASIL-B）；软件按 WCCA 计算结果设置过欠压阈值。其中 VCC3V3_EQ、VCC3V3_CAM 等经两个 10K 1% 精度电阻分压后由 MCU ADC 采样（如 VCC3V3_CAM 用 AN12 引脚，精度要求 3.3V±5%）。当软件诊断到电源电压异常时，MCU 会关断 EQ 及其他负载的工作电源，确保功能安全。

HM IDF01/F07/F25/F28/F31
模块功能 Module FunctionADAS产品支持KL15唤醒、CAN唤醒（平台预留）和以太网唤醒（平台预留）三种唤醒方式，当唤醒信号有效时直接使能一级电源，MCU开始工作并启动ADAS产品，并且MCU可以通过MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0信号辅助使能一级电源，实现off delay功能。 ADAS products support KL15 wake up, CAN wake up（Platform reservation），ETH wake up（Platform reservation）, three wake up modes. When the wake up signal is effective, the first-level power supply will be directly enabled. MCU starts to work and start the ADAS product, and the MCU can enable the first-level power supply through the MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0 signal assist to achieve the off delay function.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL15唤醒 KL15 Wake Up KL15分成两路信号： The KL15 signal divides into two signals: 一路经过防反二极管和分压电阻后用于使能一级电源LN10046，当KL15为逻辑高时有效，一级电源开始工作。并且MCU得电启动后会使能MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0引脚，通过防反接二极管辅助使能一级电源并在唤醒源掉电后实现OFF DELAY功能，确保MCU完成所有必要任务之后ADAS产品进入休眠。 One way passes through an anti-reverse diode and two divider resistors , used to enable the EN pin of the primary power supply LN10046, effective when the KL15 is logically high, the primary power supply starts working. The MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0 pin will be enabled after the MCU is powered on, and the primary power supply will be enabled through the anti-reverse diode assist, and the function of OFF DELAY will be performed after the wake source is powered off to ensure that the ADAS product will enter hibernation after the MCU completes all necessary tasks. 另一路通过防反接二极管和100K,1%、10K,1%分压电路，用于MCU的ADC采样进行是否有效判断。 用到的引脚网络是WKUP_ACQ，对应MCU的AN0引脚。 The other way through the anti-reverse diode and 100K,1%, 20K,1% voltage divider circuit, used for MCU ADC sampling to determine whether effective. The pin network used is WKUP_ACQ, which corresponds to the AN0 pin of the MCU. CAN特定帧唤醒 ADAS平台支持特定报文的CAN唤醒功能，当唤醒信号有效时会直接使能一级电源的使能信号，系统开始唤醒，MCU工作并启动整个ADAS产品工作。 CAN通讯接口，TCAN1145配置时支持CAN特定报文唤醒，TCAN1145的VBAT引脚接至UB_PR引脚，INH引脚通过分压和防反电路接至一级电源使能引脚，当CAN总线接收到唤醒报文时INH引脚为逻辑高，会使能一级电源，产品开始工作。INH信号通过一个防范二极管在通过100K和10K电阻分压后用MCU的AN11引脚采样。 2.CAN0 bus wake up The ADAS platform reserves the CAN wake-up function to support specific messages. When the wake-up signal is effective, the enable signal of the first-level power supply will be directly enabled, the system will start to wake up, and the MCU will work and start the entire ADAS product. CAN communication interface, TCAN1145 supports CAN specific message wake-up when configured, the VBAT pin of TCAN1145 is connected to UB_PR pin, The INH pin is connected to the primary power enable pin through the voltage divider and anti-reverse circuit. When the CAN bus receives the wake-up message, the INH pin is logically high, which will enable the primary power and the product will start to work. The INH signal is sampled with the AN11 pin of the MCU via a guard diode after voltage splitting through 100K and 33K resistors. 3.ETH报文唤醒 ADAS产品唤醒支持ETH报文唤醒，当唤醒信号有效时会直接使能一级电源的使能信号，系统开始唤醒，MCU工作并启动整个ADAS产品工作。ETH PHY DP83TC812R的VSLEEP引脚接至常电，INH引脚通过分压和防反电路接至一级电源使能引脚，当以太网接收到唤醒报文时INH引脚为逻辑高，会使能一级电源，产品开始工作。 3.Flexray specific packet wakeup The wakeup of ADAS products supports the wakeup of ETH message. When the wakeup signal is effective, the enable signal of the primary power supply will be directly enabled, and the system will start to wake up, and the MCU will work and start the whole ADAS product. The VSLEEP pin of the PHY DP83TC812R is connected to the Constant Power Supply, and the INH pin is connected to the primary power enable pin through the voltage divider and anti-reverse circuit. When the ETH bus receives the wake-up message, the INH pin is logically high, and the primary power is enabled and the product starts to work. 4.自保持唤醒 MCU_WKUP_HOLD 当CAN总线唤醒报文中断后，INH引脚电平会无效（逻辑低），此时MCU会通过MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0引脚进入OFF DELAY功能自保持唤醒一段时间，确保MCU完成所有必要任务之后ADAS产品进入休眠。 4. Self keeping wake up When the CAN bus wake-up frame is interrupted, the INH pin level will be invalid (low logic), and the MCU will enter the OFF DELAY function through the MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0 pin to keep awake for a period of time to ensure that the ADAS product will enter hibernation after the MCU completes all necessary tasks.

question: 板上用 TPS22918 做了哪些电源开关？逐个给出输入、输出和使能。
reference_answer: U1500：VCC3V3 到 VCC3V3_ETH，使能 MCU_3V3_ETH_EN；U1802：VCC3V3 到 VCC3V3_EQ，使能 MCU_3V3_EQ_EN；U1803：VCC1V8 到 VCC1V8_EQ，使能 MCU_1V8_EQ_EN。
response:
根据电路网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）和 HSI 设计文档，板上共有 **3 个 TPS22918 负载开关**（均为车规型号 TPS22918TDBVRQ1，SOT23X145-6 封装），逐个说明如下：

## 1. U1500 —— 3V3 转 3V3_ETH（以太网供电开关）

| 项目 | 网络/信号 |
|---|---|
| 输入 VIN | **VCC3V3** |
| 输出 VOUT（QOD 同网络） | **VCC3V3_ETH** |
| 使能 ON | **MCU_3V3_ETH_EN**（来自 MCU U900E 的 P21.0/ASCLIN11_ATX 引脚，经 R1500，测试点 TP1500） |
| CT 引脚 | N22963649（接 C1501，测试点 TP1501，用于上电斜率设置） |

HSI 文档（F17）描述：3V3 转 3V3_ETH 用于 ETH 供电，采用 TPS22918 负载开关将 VCC3V3 系统电源转换为 VCC3V3_ETH，提供给 MCU 的 ETH 供电，P21.0 引脚使能该芯片。输出 VCC3V3_ETH 后级还接了 U1501（产生 VCC1V0_ETH）。

## 2. U1802 —— 3V3 转 3V3_EQ（EQ6 3.3V 供电开关）

| 项目 | 网络/信号 |
|---|---|
| 输入 VIN | **VCC3V3** |
| 输出 VOUT（QOD 同网络） | **VCC3V3_EQ** |
| 使能 ON | **MCU_3V3_EQ_EN**（来自 MCU U900E 的 P20.3/ASCLIN3_ARXC 引脚，经 R1818，测试点 TP1822） |
| CT 引脚 | N20145936（接 C1831，测试点 TP1824） |

HSI 文档（F16）描述：TPS22918 负载开关，VCC3V3 电压输入，VCC3V3_EQ 输出。输出 VCC3V3_EQ 供给 EQ6（U400）的 VDD_RING 等电源引脚及 Y500 晶振。

## 3. U1803 —— 1V8 转 1V8_EQ（EQ6 1.8V 供电开关）

| 项目 | 网络/信号 |
|---|---|
| 输入 VIN | **VCC1V8** |
| 输出 VOUT（QOD 同网络） | **VCC1V8_EQ** |
| 使能 ON | **MCU_1V8_EQ_EN**（来自 MCU U900E 的 P20.0/CAN03_RXDC 引脚，经 R1817，测试点 TP1819） |
| CT 引脚 | N20146977（接 C1833，测试点 TP1820） |

HSI 文档（F19）描述：1V8 转 1V8_EQ 用于 EQ6 供电，采用 TPS22918 负载开关将 VCC1V8 电源转换为 VCC1V8_EQ 给 EQ6 供电，用 MCU 的 P20.0 引脚使能。输出 VCC1V8_EQ 再经 L600~L604 磁珠分配到 EQ6 的 OTP、TSENS、PLLS、DDR_PLLS、XTAL 等 1.8V 电源域，以及 MIPI VPH 引脚。

## 汇总表

| 位号 | 输入 (VIN) | 输出 (VOUT) | 使能 (ON) | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| U1500 | VCC3V3 | VCC3V3_ETH | MCU_3V3_ETH_EN（MCU P21.0） | 以太网 ETH 供电 |
| U1802 | VCC3V3 | VCC3V3_EQ | MCU_3V3_EQ_EN（MCU P20.3） | EQ6 3.3V 供电 |
| U1803 | VCC1V8 | VCC1V8_EQ | MCU_1V8_EQ_EN（MCU P20.0） | EQ6 1.8V 供电 |

三个开关均由 MCU（TC377，U900E）GPIO 独立使能控制，CT 引脚各接一个电容设定上电时序（软启动斜率），输出端 QOD 引脚与 VOUT 同网络（TPS22918 的快速输出放电功能在该设计中未单独接下拉电阻网络）。

模块功能 Module Function系统使用车载电池12V电压供电，经过EMI电路后输入至电源转换芯片，转换输出系统各模块所需电源。 The system uses 12V voltage power supply from the vehicle battery, which is input to the power conversion chip through the EMI circuit. Then the power conversion chip convert and output the power required by each module of the system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. VCC3V3_MCU to VCC1V25_MCU(ASILB) 3V3转1V25_MCU是使用MCU内置控制器进行控制的BUCK电源，用于MCU的核供电，功能安全需求达到ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 3V3 to 1V25_MCU is a BUCK power supply controlled by MCU built-in controller, which is used for MCU nuclear power supply. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. VCC3V3 to VCC0V75(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC0V75应用于EQ6的内核供电，要求输出电流能力大，现选型TI的电源方案TPS62872。用MCU的P22.0引脚使能芯片，用MCU_SDA_P15.5，MCU_SCL_P15.4引脚I2C通信来设置输出电压和通信。 VCC3V3 to VCC0V75 is applied to the core power supply of EQ6, which requires large output current capacity. The power supply scheme TPS62872 of TI is selected. P22.0 pin of MCU is used to enable the chip, and MCU_SDA_P15.5, MCU_SCL_P15.4 pin I2C communication is used to set the output voltage and communication. question: 以太网 PHY 的 1.0V 电源如何一级级供出来？
reference_answer: 供电链路为 VCC3V3 → U1500（TPS22918，ON=MCU_3V3_ETH_EN）→ VCC3V3_ETH → U1501（TPS74501 LDO）→ VCC1V0_ETH。
response:
根据知识库中的原理图（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）和 HSI 设计文档，以太网 PHY 的 1.0V 电源是**三级级联**供出来的，链路如下：

## 电源链路总览

```
KL30/UBD (车载电池 9~16V)
   │  EMI 滤波保护电路
   ▼
一级电源 LN10046 (KL30→VCC3V3，系统一级 DC-DC，ASIL-B)
   │
   ▼
VCC3V3（系统主电源轨）
   │  U1500 = TPS22918 负载开关（MCU_3V3_ETH_EN 使能）
   ▼
VCC3V3_ETH（以太网域 3.3V 电源）
   │  U1501（器件库编号 2025011410722，带反馈分压的稳压器）
   ▼
VCC1V0_ETH（PHY 1.0V 电源）
```

## 各级说明

**第 1 级：KL30 → VCC3V3（系统一级电源）**
- 车载电池 12V 经 KL30 供电口 EMI 电路（ESD 电容 + 双向 TVS 管）保护滤波后，输入一级电源转换芯片（HSI 文档 F11/F12 模块）。
- "KL30 转 VCC3V3 是系统一级 DC-DC，给 MCU 提供 VCC3V3_MCU 电源，系统要求其满足 ASIL-B"。
- 唤醒信号（KL15/CAN/以太网唤醒）有效时直接使能一级电源 LN10046，上电流程为：WKUP=H → LN10046 ACTIVE → 3V3 ACTIVE → TC377 启动 → MCU ETH POWER ACTIVE。

**第 2 级：VCC3V3 → VCC3V3_ETH（负载开关）**
- HSI 文档 F17/F13 明确："采用 TPS22918 负载开关，将 VCC3V3 系统电源转换为 VCC3V3_ETH，提供给 MCU 的 ETH 供电。P21.0 引脚使能该芯片"。
- MCU 通过将 **MCU_3V3_ETH_EN** 信号配置为逻辑高使能输出，逻辑低关闭（HSI F17 运行模式定义）。
- 原理图该页标注：IMAX=0.25A（仅有唤醒需求时使用 MAX=0.129A），且"电源模块靠近 ETH 模块放置"。

When the wake up signal is effective, the first-level power supply will be directly enabled. MCU starts to work and start the ADAS product, and the MCU can enable the first-level power supply through the MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0 signal assist to achieve the off delay function.

模块方案 Module solutionKL15唤醒 KL15 Wake Up KL15分成两路信号： The KL15 signal divides into two signals: 一路经过防反二极管和分压电阻后用于使能一级电源LN10046，当KL15为逻辑高时有效，一级电源开始工作。并且MCU得电启动后会使能MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0引脚，通过防反接二极管辅助使能一级电源并在唤醒源掉电后实现OFF DELAY功能，确保MCU完成所有必要任务之后ADAS产品进入休眠。 One way passes through an anti-reverse diode and two divider resistors , used to enable the EN pin of the primary power supply LN10046, effective when the KL15 is logically high, the primary power supply starts working. The MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0 pin will be enabled after the MCU is powered on, and the primary power supply will be enabled through the anti-reverse diode assist, and the function of OFF DELAY will be performed after the wake source is powered off to ensure that the ADAS product will enter hibernation after the MCU completes all necessary tasks. 另一路通过防反接二极管和100K,1%、10K,1%分压电路，用于MCU的ADC采样进行是否有效判断。 用到的引脚网络是WKUP_ACQ，对应MCU的AN0引脚。 The other way through the anti-reverse diode and 100K,1%, 20K,1% voltage divider circuit, used for MCU ADC sampling to determine whether effective. The pin network used is WKUP_ACQ, which corresponds to the AN0 pin of the MCU. CAN特定帧唤醒 ADAS平台支持特定报文的CAN唤醒功能，当唤醒信号有效时会直接使能一级电源的使能信号，系统开始唤醒，MCU工作并启动整个ADAS产品工作。 CAN通讯接口，TCAN1145配置时支持CAN特定报文唤醒，TCAN1145的VBAT引脚接至UB_PR引脚，INH引脚通过分压和防反电路接至一级电源使能引脚，当CAN总线接收到唤醒报文时INH引脚为逻辑高，会使能一级电源，产品开始工作。INH信号通过一个防范二极管在通过100K和10K电阻分压后用MCU的AN11引脚采样。 2.CAN0 bus wake up The ADAS platform reserves the CAN wake-up function to support specific messages. When the wake-up signal is effective, the enable signal of the first-level power supply will be directly enabled, the system will start to wake up, and the MCU will work and start the entire ADAS product. CAN communication interface, TCAN1145 supports CAN specific message wake-up when configured, the VBAT pin of TCAN1145 is connected to UB_PR pin, The INH pin is connected to the primary power enable pin through the voltage divider and anti-reverse circuit. When the CAN bus receives the wake-up message, the INH pin is logically high, which will enable the primary power and the product will start to work. When the wakeup signal is effective, the enable signal of the primary power supply will be directly enabled, and the system will start to wake up, and the MCU will work and start the whole ADAS product. The VSLEEP pin of the PHY DP83TC812R is connected to the Constant Power Supply, and the INH pin is connected to the primary power enable pin through the voltage divider and anti-reverse circuit. When the ETH bus receives the wake-up message, the INH pin is logically high, and the primary power is enabled and the product starts to work. 4.自保持唤醒 MCU_WKUP_HOLD 当CAN总线唤醒报文中断后，INH引脚电平会无效（逻辑低），此时MCU会通过MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0引脚进入OFF DELAY功能自保持唤醒一段时间，确保MCU完成所有必要任务之后ADAS产品进入休眠。 4. Self keeping wake up When the CAN bus wake-up frame is interrupted, the INH pin level will be invalid (low logic), and the MCU will enter the OFF DELAY function through the MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0 pin to keep awake for a period of time to ensure that the ADAS product will enter hibernation after the MCU completes all necessary tasks.

The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. Then the power conversion chip convert and output the power required by each module of the system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. UBSW_ACQ_AN6信号是UBD经过100K 1%、10K 1%电阻分压后的模拟信号。 UBSW_ACQ_AN6 signal is an analog signal of UBD divided by 100K 1%、10K 1% resistors. Which is connected to the ADC pin of MCU for sampling. question: 主控 MCU 是哪颗，型号是什么？
reference_answer: EDF 中 U900 为 SAK-TC367DP-64F300S，即 AURIX TC367；HSI 章节名称写作 TC377 最小系统。回答应披露 TC367 与 TC377 的来源差异，不能合并为无冲突的单一型号。
response:
根据知识库中的资料（ADAS HSI 硬件规格文档及电路网表），主控 MCU 信息如下：

## 主控 MCU 型号

**32 位 MCU 芯片 TC377，完整型号：SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA**

### 关键信息（来源：ADAS HSI 文档，HM ID F01 模块）

| 项目 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| 主控芯片 | SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA（TC377 最小系统模块） |
| 功能安全等级 | 最高可达 **ASIL-D**，满足应用要求 |
| 时钟设计 | 外部 **20MHz 晶振**提供时钟输入，由内部 PLL 电路完成倍频、分频，供内核和各模块使用 |
| 供电 | 由系统一级 DC-DC（KL30 转 VCC3V3，ASIL-B）提供 VCC3V3_MCU 电源；另有 3V3 转 1V25_MCU 为 MCU 核供电 |

### 电路中的对应关系

- 在系统框图中，MCU 对应模块 **[F01]**，其内部包含 **MCU TC377、ADC、GPIO、PORST、WATCHDOG** 等子模块；
- 在原理图网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）中，MCU 器件实例为 **U900**（如 U900D/U900E），其引脚（P00.x/P02.x/P20.x 等）挂接了 QSPI3、ASCLIN、EVADC、GPT120、CAN 等外设信号，与 TC377 的外设资源一致。

### 补充说明

- 该 MCU 外接 4 路 CAN 收发器（TCAN1046A，CAN0~CAN3，通过 SPI3 控制）和 1 路 100BASE-T1 车载以太网 PHY（DP83TC812R）；
- MCU 还通过 NXB0104 电平转换芯片对 NAND FLASH（1V8_SPI）进行读写，并与图像处理 SOC **EYEQ6-L**（Mobileye，ASIL-B）协同工作——注意 EYEQ6-L 是图像处理 SOC，**不是**主控 MCU。

After comprehensive evaluation, Mobileye product EYEQ6-L is selected, and the highest functional safety can reach ASIL-B with abundant interface resources. + 2、时钟 硬件选型30MHz晶振给EYEQ6-L提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。外部20MHz有源晶振作为内部监控时钟。 2.Clock The 30MHz crystal provides clock input to the EYEQ6-L, and its internal PLL circuit completes frequency multiplication and frequency division for the EyeQ6-L core and each module. The external 20MHz active crystal is energized as an internal monitoring clock. 3、DDR EYEQ6在外扩的DDR中运行程序和存储临时数据，其DDR控制器可支持32bits位宽的LPDDR4 SDRAM，最大读写速率4266 Mb/s/pin 。本设计中选用1片32bit的LPDDR4 SDRAM，型号为车规级器件K4F8E3S4HD-GHCL02V，以充分利用数据带宽，保证EYEQ6的处理速度，LPDDR4工作环境温度为-40℃~105℃，单片总容量1GB。 3.DDR EYEQ6 runs programs and stores temporary data in the extended DDR. Its DDR controller supports LPDDR4 SDRAM with 32bits wide and a maximum read/write rate of 4266Mb/s/pin. In this design, a 32bit LPDDR4 SDRAM is selected, the model is car grade device K4F8E3S4HD-GHCLO2V, in order to make full use of the data bandwidth and ensure the processing speed of EYEQ6. The working environment temperature of LPDDR4 is -40℃-105℃, and the total capacity of a single chip is 1GB. 4、NAND FLASH 选择ME推荐的WinBond公司产品W35N02JWTBKF，容量2Gb，FLASH支持CRC安全机制。 NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_ SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_ SPI进行电平转换，通过MCU_SPI1_CS片选电平转换芯片，实现MCU对NAND FLASH的读写操作，转换芯片在本应用场景下支持最大传输速率80Mbps。 NAND FLASH Choose the WinBond company product W35N02JWTBKF recommended by ME, with a capacity of 2Gb and FLASH supporting CRC security mechanism. NXB0104 is used for the level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8_SPI of NAND FLASH. The level conversion chip is selected by MCU_SPI1_CS chip to realize the reading and writing operation of MCU to NAND FLASH. The converter chip supports a maximum transmission rate of 80Mbps in this application scenario. 5、电源和复位 EYEQ6-L需要6路电源：VCC3V3_EQ、VCC0V75、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC1V8_EQ，其中VCC0V75用于给内核供电。复位信号由MCU通过P02.4口进行控制。 Power and reset EYEQ6-L requires six power sources: VCC3V3-EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V8_EQ, where VCCOV75 is used to power the core. The reset signal is controlled by the MCU through the P02.4 pin.

模块方案 Module solution处理器 根据ADAS产品需求，综合评估选型为32位MCU芯片SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA， MCU接口资源丰富，功能安全等级最高可达到ASIL-D，满足应用要求。 Processor According to ADAS product requirements, 32-bit MCU chip SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA is selected through comprehensive evaluation, which has rich MCU interface resources and the highest functional safety level can reach ASIL-D to meet application requirements 时钟设计 硬件选型20MHz晶振给MCU提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。 Clock design Hardware selection of clock design 20MHz crystal oscillator provides clock input to MCU, and its internal PLL and other circuits complete frequency doubling and frequency division for its kernel and each module. 复位及watchdog 系统复位及看门狗芯片采用LP87702内部看门狗，喂狗方式为窗口喂狗，当喂狗窗口无有效喂狗次数超过OTP配置时，将触发整个系统复位。 a) 上电时，看门狗芯片对MCU启动过程进行监控，同时对MCU的电源VCC3V3电压进行低压监控，异常时主动复位MCU。 b) 运行过程中由看门狗监控MCU运行状态，当MCU程序跑飞时看门狗超时触发复位信号主动复位MCU。 Reset and watchdog The system reset and watchdog chip adopts LP87702 internal watchdog, and the feeding method is window feeding. When the number of effective dog feeding in the feeding window exceeds the OTP configuration, the whole system reset will be triggered. When powering on, the watchdog chip monitors the start-up process of MCU, and at the same time, it monitors the low voltage voltage of MCU's power supply VCC3V3, and actively resets MCU when abnormal. MCU running status is monitored by watchdog during operation. When MCU program runs, watchdog timeout triggers reset signal and actively reset MCU. 电源需求 MCU需要1路VCC3V3_MCU（精度：3.3V±10%）和1路VCC1V25_MCU（精度：1.2-1.35V）供电。 4. Power demand The MCU needs 1 channel VCC3V3_MCU (accuracy: 3.3V±10%) and 1 channel VCC1V25_MCU (accuracy: 1.2-1.35V) power supply.

HM IDF11/F12/F13/F14/F15/F16/F17/F18/F19/F25/F27
模块功能 Module Function系统使用车载电池12V电压供电，经过EMI电路后输入至电源转换芯片，转换输出系统各模块所需电源。 The system uses 12V voltage power supply from the vehicle battery, which is input to the power conversion chip through the EMI circuit. Then the power conversion chip convert and output the power required by each module of the system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. VCC3V3_MCU to VCC1V25_MCU(ASILB) 3V3转1V25_MCU是使用MCU内置控制器进行控制的BUCK电源，用于MCU的核供电，功能安全需求达到ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 3V3 to 1V25_MCU is a BUCK power supply controlled by MCU built-in controller, which is used for MCU nuclear power supply. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. VCC3V3 to VCC0V75(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC0V75应用于EQ6的内核供电，要求输出电流能力大，现选型TI的电源方案TPS62872。用MCU的P22.0引脚使能芯片，用MCU_SDA_P15.5，MCU_SCL_P15.4引脚I2C通信来设置输出电压和通信。 VCC3V3 to VCC0V75 is applied to the core power supply of EQ6, which requires large output current capacity. The power supply scheme TPS62872 of TI is selected. P22.0 pin of MCU is used to enable the chip, and MCU_SDA_P15.5, MCU_SCL_P15.4 pin I2C communication is used to set the output voltage and communication. VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR(QM(B)) VCC3V3转0V75_MIPI_DDR用于EQ6的IO口供电，现使用矽力杰的SA23002进行设计。用MCU的P22.1引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR for EQ6 IO port power supply, Silergy’s SA23002 is designed. The P22.1 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3转VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50(QM(B)) VCC1V8用于EQ6、CAM、DDR、FLASH供电，VCC1V1用于EQ6、DDR供电，VCC50用于CAN收发器供电，现选择LP87702 PMIC方案。用MCU的P15.3引脚使能该芯片的5V输出，用MCU_SCL_P15.4，MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C通信来设置1.8V和1.1V输出电压和使能。 VCC1V8 is used for EQ6, CAM, DDR, FLASH power supply, VCC1V1 is used for EQ6, DDR power supply, VCC50 is used for CAN transceiver power supply, LP87702 PMIC scheme is selected. P15.3 pin of MCU is used to enable 5V output of the chip, and MCU_SCL_P15.4, MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C communication is used to set 1.8V and 1.1V output voltage and enable it. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC3V3_EQ用于EQ6的IO和摄像头供电，现使用负载开关进行设计。用MCU的P20.3引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ for EQ6’s IO and camera power supply, now using the load switch is designed. .The P20.3 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_ETH(QM) 3V3转3V3_ETH用于ETH供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P21.0引脚使能该芯片。 3V3 to 3V3_ETH for ETH power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P21.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ(QM(B)) VCC1V8转VCC1V8_EQ用于EQ供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P20.0引脚使能该芯片。 VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ for EQ power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P20.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip.

question: 板上最主要的电源管理芯片是谁？说清楚输入、三路输出和软件配置出处。
reference_answer: U1700 LP87702-Q1 从 VCC3V3 取电，关键输出为 VCC1V1、VCC1V8、VCC50，软件配置出处为 HSI 7.2 节。
response:
# 板上最主要的电源管理芯片：TI **LP87702（LP87702-Q1）**

## 一、结论与角色定位

根据两份硬件软/硬件接口文档（HSI）的一致描述，**LP87702 是板上负责二次电源转换的核心电源管理芯片（PMIC）**，实现 **VCC3V3 → VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50 三路电源输出**：

> "1、LP87702实现VCC3V3转VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50三路电源输出；2、LP87702的VCC50由MCU的GPIO控制使能和关断，VCC1V8、VCC1V1由MCU的I2C控制使能和关断；3、预留中断信号用于MCU辅助监控LP87702的工作状态；4、MCU可以通过I2C监控和管理LP87702的状态。"
> —— 出处：`600608964_ADAS_HSI_0506_1952_shoulin.wang.docx` 与 `600608964_ADAS_HSI_1788344617671675640_05e41fa1.docx`（HM ID：F13/POWER，硬件接口组件安全等级 QM(B)）

在原理网表 `825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF` 中，该 PMIC 对应器件位号 **U1700**：
- 电源拓扑证据：`VCC3V3 -> U1700 (20200424007) -> VCC50`，即 U1700 从 VCC3V3 取电、输出 VCC50；
- 中断信号证据：网络 `MCU_nINT_PMIC_P12.1` 连接 `U1700.nINT` 与 MCU（U900D）的 P12.1 引脚，与文档"预留中断信号辅助监控 LP87702"的描述吻合；
- I2C 证据：PMIC 模块组通过 `MCU_SCL_P15.4` 网络与 MCU 侧相连。

## 二、输入电源链路（完整路径）

| 级联 | 内容 | 出处 |
|---|---|---|
| 1. 电池输入 | 车载电池 12V（KL30）供电，先经 **EMI 电路**（UBD 网络两个串联 ESD 电容 + 双向 TVS 管，靠近主连接器布局），ASIL-B | HSI 文档"KL30 EMI (ASIL-B)"章节（HM ID F11/F12/F13…） |
| 2. 一级 DC-DC | **LN10046** 将 KL30 12V 转为 **VCC3V3**（系统一级 DC-DC，给 MCU 提供 VCC3V3_MCU，要求 ASIL-B） | HSI 文档 HM ID F12："KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，基于LN10046设计" |
| 3. PMIC 输入 | **VCC3V3 作为 LP87702（U1700）的输入**，再转出三路电源 | HSI F13/POWER 描述 + 网表电源拓扑 `VCC3V3 -> U1700 -> VCC50` |

## 三、三路输出及控制方式

| 输出 | 使能/关断控制 | 监控 |
|---|---|---|
| **VCC50** | MCU GPIO **MCU_5V_EN**（引脚 P15.3）：高=使能 VCC50 输出，低=关断 | MCU 通过 I2C 监控管理；ADC 采样监控 |
| **VCC1V8** | MCU 通过 **I2C**（SDA=P15.5 / SCL=P15.4）控制使能和关断 | 同上；VCC1V8 由 AN3 引脚直接 ADC 采样 |
| **VCC1V1** | MCU 通过 **I2C** 控制使能和关断 | 同上；VCC1V1 由 AN4 引脚直接 ADC 采样 |

- 出处：HSI 文档 F13/POWER 功能描述、ECU-MCU 信号对应关系（MCU_5V_EN 定义）、"EQ6系统电源电压采样"章节（HM ID F01/F08/F09，要求 ASIL-B 的板内电源 ADC 采样与异常监控）。
- LP87702 运行模式（HM ID F13）：**SHUTDOWN / READ OTP / STANDBY / ACTIVE** 四种模式，由 VANA 电压与 NRST 阈值决定，ACTIVE 模式下 DC/DC 使能、全部寄存器可被 MCU 通过系统串口读写。

## 四、软件配置出处

1. **《LP87702配置 LP87702 Configuration》（HSI 文档第 7.2 节，约 p.72）**：明确"LP87702运行期间需要MCU通过I2C配置的寄存器如下所示：**Table 5-2 LP87702 Configuration**"——这是软件配置 LP87702 寄存器的正式出处。
2. **《电源电路 Power Circuit》（第 3.3.3 节，约 p.42）**：含"VCC3V3转VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50"专节，描述三路输出的硬件方案。
3. **ECU-MCU 信号对应关系（第 6.1 节）**：定义 MCU_5V_EN（P15.3）对 VCC50 的 GPIO 使能控制，及 I2C 引脚分配。
4. **ADC 电压采集阈值（第 4 节）+ WCCA 过欠压阈值**："软件应按照如下过欠压阈值设置"，用于对 LP87702 输出电压的异常监控。

## 五、证据范围与未尽事项说明

- ✅ 已确认：LP87702 的输入（VCC3V3，上游为 KL30→LN10046）、三路输出（VCC1V8/VCC1V1/VCC50）、GPIO+I2C 控制方式、中断监控、运行模式、软件配置章节位置。
- ⚠️ 未取到：**Table 5-2 中 LP87702 具体寄存器地址/取值表内容**（检索仅命中该表标题与章节目录）；网表按"LP87702"型号名直接解析时未返回器件级证据（工具提示需 BOM/位号补充），但 U1700 通过电源拓扑（VCC50 输出）与 nINT_PMIC 中断网络可间接锁定为该 PMIC。
- 补充说明：板上其他电源芯片（一级 DC-DC **LN10046**、EQ6 内核供电 **TPS62872**、以及 SA23002、TPS22918 等）各司其职，但"单芯片输出三路电源、由 MCU 通过 I2C+GPIO 统一管理"的电源管理芯片只有 **LP87702**。

模块功能 Module Function系统使用车载电池12V电压供电，经过EMI电路后输入至电源转换芯片，转换输出系统各模块所需电源。 The system uses 12V voltage power supply from the vehicle battery, which is input to the power conversion chip through the EMI circuit. Then the power conversion chip convert and output the power required by each module of the system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. VCC3V3_MCU to VCC1V25_MCU(ASILB) 3V3转1V25_MCU是使用MCU内置控制器进行控制的BUCK电源，用于MCU的核供电，功能安全需求达到ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 3V3 to 1V25_MCU is a BUCK power supply controlled by MCU built-in controller, which is used for MCU nuclear power supply. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. VCC3V3 to VCC0V75(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC0V75应用于EQ6的内核供电，要求输出电流能力大，现选型TI的电源方案TPS62872。用MCU的P22.0引脚使能芯片，用MCU_SDA_P15.5，MCU_SCL_P15.4引脚I2C通信来设置输出电压和通信。 VCC3V3 to VCC0V75 is applied to the core power supply of EQ6, which requires large output current capacity. The power supply scheme TPS62872 of TI is selected. P22.0 pin of MCU is used to enable the chip, and MCU_SDA_P15.5, MCU_SCL_P15.4 pin I2C communication is used to set the output voltage and communication. VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR(QM(B)) VCC3V3转0V75_MIPI_DDR用于EQ6的IO口供电，现使用矽力杰的SA23002进行设计。用MCU的P22.1引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR for EQ6 IO port power supply, Silergy’s SA23002 is designed. The P22.1 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3转VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50(QM(B)) VCC1V8用于EQ6、CAM、DDR、FLASH供电，VCC1V1用于EQ6、DDR供电，VCC50用于CAN收发器供电，现选择LP87702 PMIC方案。用MCU的P15.3引脚使能该芯片的5V输出，用MCU_SCL_P15.4，MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C通信来设置1.8V和1.1V输出电压和使能。 VCC1V8 is used for EQ6, CAM, DDR, FLASH power supply, VCC1V1 is used for EQ6, DDR power supply, VCC50 is used for CAN transceiver power supply, LP87702 PMIC scheme is selected. P15.3 pin of MCU is used to enable 5V output of the chip, and MCU_SCL_P15.4, MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C communication is used to set 1.8V and 1.1V output voltage and enable it. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC3V3_EQ用于EQ6的IO和摄像头供电，现使用负载开关进行设计。用MCU的P20.3引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ for EQ6’s IO and camera power supply, now using the load switch is designed. .The P20.3 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_ETH(QM) 3V3转3V3_ETH用于ETH供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P21.0引脚使能该芯片。 3V3 to 3V3_ETH for ETH power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P21.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ(QM(B)) VCC1V8转VCC1V8_EQ用于EQ供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P20.0引脚使能该芯片。 VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ for EQ power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P20.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip.

模式定义 Definition of Operation mode上电模式 Power on 当唤醒信号有效后，系统一级电源输出VCC3V3电源，MCU开始工作，MCU_UB_SW_P00.10信号输出逻辑高，使能KL30电压采样电路，之后UBSW_ACQ输出分压后的模拟信号，MCU开始通过ADC采样UBSW_ACQ信号。 1. Power on When the wake-up signal becomes active, the system's primary power supply outputs the VCC3V3 voltage, and the MCU starts operating. The MCU_UB_SW_P00.10 signal then outputs a logic high level to enable the KL30 voltage sampling circuit. Subsequently, UBSW_ACQ outputs a divided analog signal, after which the MCU begins ADC sampling of the UBSW_ACQ signal.运行模式 MCU实时采样UBSW_ACQ用于电源管理功能。 2.Run mode MCU real-time sampling UBSW_ACQ is used for power management functions. 下电模式 唤醒信号无效后，MCU在off delay期间将MCU_UB_SW_P00.10信号配置为逻辑低，关闭KL30采样功能，系统下电。 3. Power off After the wake-up signal is invalid, the MCU will configure the MCU_UB_Sw_P00.10 signal to logic low during offdelay, turn off the KL30 sampling function, and power down the system.

HM IDF20/F21/F22/F23
运行模式 Operation Mode运行模式、待机模式、Sleep模式、OFF模式、Overtemp模式 Run mode, standby mode, Sleep mode, OFF mode, Overtemp mode.
模式定义 Definition of Operation modeTCAN1044A： 1、 运行模式 STB设置为低电平使能Normal模式，收发器可以通过总线CANH和CANL发送接收数据。 2、 待机模式 STB设置为高电平使能Standby模式，收发器将不再发送接收数据。 1.Run mode The STB is set to low to enable Normal mode, and the transceiver can send and receive data through the bus CANH and CANL. 2.Standby mode The STB is set to high level enable Standby mode, and the transceiver will no longer send the received data. TCAN1145： 1、Normal模式 通过SPI3配置寄存器MC=111进入Normal模式，收发器可以通过总线CANH和CANL发送接收数据。 2、Standby模式 通过SPI3配置寄存器MC=100，使能Standby模式，收发器将不再发送接收数据，但INH引脚依然有效。 3、Sleep模式 通过SPI3配置寄存器MC=001或者发生欠压事件，CAN收发器进入sleep模式。该模式下INH为高阻态。 与TJA1145寄存器地址有差别，软件开发需要注意。 4、Off模式 当电源电压过低无法为IC供电，收发器进入Off模式，该模式下CAN引脚和INH引脚为高阻态。 5、Overtemp模式 当芯片整体温度高于阈值，会进入过温模式，该模式下收发器的发送端和接收端被禁用，INH引脚为高阻态。 Normal mode The Normal mode is entered through SPI3 configuration register MC=111, and the transceiver can send and receive data through buses CANH and CANL. Standby mode By configuring the SPI3 register MC=100 to enable the Standby mode, the transceiver will no longer send the received data, but the INH pin will remain active. Sleep mode Through SPI3 configuration register MC=001 or an undervoltage event occurs, the CAN transceiver goes into sleep mode. In this mode, INH is in the high impedance state. HM IDF01/F08/F09
模块功能 Module Function系统需求需要板内电源电压进行ADC采样和异常监控，要求功能安全达到ASIL-B等级，确保EQ6系统工作安全。 The system requirements require the on-board power supply voltage for ADC sampling and anomaly monitoring, and the functional safety is required to reach ASIL-B level to ensure the working safety of EQ6 system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionEQ6系统电源电压采样 系统需求需要MCU对LP87702、TPS62872、SA23002、TPS22918和摄像头端的电压VCC3V3_EQ，VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC3V3_CAM，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM进行ADC采样和异常监控。其中VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM电压范围未超量程对电压直接采样。VCC3V3_EQ和VCC3V3_CAM经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_EQ用AN2引脚采样，VCC1V8用AN3引脚采样，VCC1V1用AN4引脚采样，VCC1V8_EQ用AN5引脚采样，VCC3V3_CAM用AN12引脚采样，VCC1V1_CAM用AN13引脚采样，VCC1V8_CAM用AN14引脚采样，VCC0V75_MIPI_DDR用AN18引脚采样，VCC0V75用AN19引脚采样。 EQ6 system power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the voltages VCC3V3_EQ, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC3V3_CAM, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM for the LP87702, TPS62872, SA23002, TPS22918, and camera-side devices. Among these voltages, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM have voltage ranges within the measurement range and are directly sampled. VCC3V3_EQ and VCC3V3_CAM are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_EQ is sampled using AN2, VCC1V8 using AN3, VCC1V1 using AN4, VCC1V8_EQ using AN5, VCC3V3_CAM using AN12, VCC1V1_CAM using AN13, VCC_1V8_CAM using AN14, 0V75_MIPI_DDR using AN18, and VCC0V75 using AN19. CANÐ电源电压采样 系统需求MCU对LP87702、TPS22918的输出电压VCC3V3_ETH，VCC50进行ADC采样和异常监控，VCC3V3_ETH和VCC50经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_ETH用AN8引脚采样，VCC50用AN1引脚采样。 CANÐ power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the output voltages VCC3V3_ETH and VCC50 from the LP87702 and TPS22918. Both VCC3V3_ETH and VCC50 are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_ETH is sampled using AN8, and VCC50 is sampled using AN1.

HM IDF13
运行模式 Operation ModeSHUTDOWN、READ OTP、STANDBY、ACTIVE
模式定义 Definition of Operation modeSHUTDOWN NRST电压低于阈值。LP87702-Q1器件停止工作。 READ OTP 电源电压VANA高于VANAUVLO电平，并且NRST电压高于阈值电平。电压转换器被禁用，LP87702-Q1的参考电平和偏置电路被启用。OTP配置被加载到寄存器。 STANDBY 电源电压VANA高于VANAUVLO水平，NRST电压高于阈值水平。电压转换器被禁用，LP87702-Q1的参考电平、控制和偏压电路被启用。所有的寄存器都可以被主机处理器通过系统串口读写。电压转换器可以根据需要进行使能输出。 ACTIVE 电源电压VANA高于VANAUVLO水平，NRST电压高于阈值水平。稳压DC/DC变换器处于使能状态。所有的寄存器都可以被MCU通过系统串口读写。 SHUTDOWN After the enable signal MCU_OV75_MIPI_DDR_EN=L, the secondary power stops the 0V75_MIPI_DDR power supply. READY OTP The supply voltage VANA is above the VANAUVLO level, and the NRST voltage is above the threshold level. The voltage converter is disabled and the reference level and bias circuits of the LP87702-Q1 are enabled. The OTP configuration is loaded into the register. STANDBY The supply voltage VANA is above the VANAUVLO level and the NRST voltage is above the threshold level. The voltage converter is disabled and the reference level, control, and bias circuits of the LP87702-Q1 are enabled. All registers can be read and written by the host processor through the system serial port. The voltage converter can perform enabling output as needed. ACTIVE The supply voltage VANA is above the VANAUVLO level and the NRST voltage is above the threshold level. The regulated DC/DC converter is in the enabled state. All the registers can be read and written by the MCU through the system serial port.

question: U1800 的输入、输出检测、使能和 I²C 控制网络分别是什么？
reference_answer: U1800 是 TPS62872，VIN 为 VCC3V3，VOSNS 为 VCC0V75，EN 接 N19888813，并通过连接到 MCU 的 SDA/SCL 进行 I²C 控制。
response:
根据电路网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）中的引脚映射，U1800 为 **TPS62872Y1QWRXSRQ1**（TI 降压转换器，PQFN50P355X255X105-16 封装），其相关网络如下：

## U1800 关键网络

| 功能 | 引脚 | 连接网络 |
|------|------|----------|
| **输入（VIN）** | VIN（两个引脚） | **VCC3V3** |
| **输出电压检测（VOSNS）** | VOSNS | **VCC0V75** |
| **地检测（GOSNS）** | GOSNS | **GND** |
| **使能（EN）** | EN | **N19888813** |
| **I²C 数据（SDA）** | SDA | **MCU_SDA_P15.5** |
| **I²C 时钟（SCL）** | SCL | **MCU_SCL_P15.4** |

## 补充说明

- **输入**：VIN 引脚接 3.3V 电源轨 **VCC3V3**。
- **输出检测**：VOSNS（输出电压检测）接 **VCC0V75**，即该 buck 输出的 0.75V 电源轨；GOSNS（地检测）接 GND，用于远端地检测。开关节点 SW 经网络 **N19808656**（通常接功率电感）。
- **使能**：EN 引脚接内部网络 **N19888813**（非直接命名电源轨，一般经分压/控制逻辑驱动）。
- **I²C 控制**：SDA 接 MCU 的 **P15.5**，SCL 接 MCU 的 **P15.4**，用于对该器件进行寄存器配置；MODE/SYNC 引脚接 VCC3V3。
- 其他：PG（Power Good）和 SYNC_OUT 在源文件中未声明网络连接（NC）；VSEL 接 N19808994，FSEL 接 N19808812，COMP 接 N19809013（补偿网络），TAB 接 GND。

question: VCC1V8 到 EQ 的 1.8V 电源经过哪颗负载开关，使能信号是什么？
reference_answer: VCC1V8 经 U1803（TPS22918）输出为 VCC1V8_EQ，使能信号为 MCU_1V8_EQ_EN。
response:
根据知识库中的电路网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）和硬件接口文档（ADAS HSI），该问题有明确答案：

## 答案

**负载开关：TPS22918（位号 U1803）**

### 电路连接（来自原理图网表）

| U1803 引脚 | 连接网络 |
|---|---|
| VIN | VCC1V8（输入） |
| ON | **MCU_1V8_EQ_EN**（使能） |
| VOUT / QOD | VCC1V8_EQ（输出，给 EQ6 供电） |
| GND | GND |

- 器件型号：TPS22918TDBVRQ1，SOT23-6 封装
- 功能：将 VCC1V8 电源转换为 VCC1V8_EQ，专用于 EQ6（EYEQ6-L）供电

### 使能信号

- **信号名：MCU_1V8_EQ_EN**
- 由 MCU（F01）的 **P20.0 引脚**（封装引脚 H20，复用功能含 GTM_TOUT59 等）以 GPIO 输出方式控制
- 控制逻辑：
  - **高电平**：使能 VCC1V8_EQ 电源输出（上电模式，EQ 系统供电）
  - **低电平**：关断 VCC1V8_EQ 电源输出（下电模式）
- 引脚默认状态：HI-Z，硬件外部下拉（即 MCU 未驱动时默认关断）

### 补充说明

文档中同时提到 EQ 相关还有一路 3V3 电源：U1802（同为 TPS22918）将 VCC3V3 转为 VCC3V3_EQ，使能信号为 MCU_3V3_EQ_EN（MCU P20.3 引脚）。注意区分：**1.8V 这一路对应的是 U1803 / MCU_1V8_EQ_EN / P20.0**。此外文档提示需注意 EQ 的上下电时序要求。

HM IDF02/F03/F04/F28
模块功能 Module FunctionEYEQ6-L最小系统组成：外部30MHz晶体给EYEQ6-L提供基本时钟输入，外部20MHz有源晶振提供监控时钟，外扩OSPI接口的2Gb NAND FLASH存储程序，外扩1GB的LPDDR4运存。NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_SPI进行电平转换，用于MCU读写NAND FLASH。 EYEQ6-L minimum system components: an external 30MHz crystal provides the basic clock input for EYEQ6-L, an external 20MHz active crystal provides the monitoring clock, an external 2GbNAND FLASH memory program for OSPI interface, and an external 1GB LPDDR4 operation memory. NXB0104 is used for level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8-SPI of NAND FLASH for MCU to read and write NAND FLASH.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solution 1、处理器 根据ADAS产品需求图像处理SOC功能安全需要达到ASIL-B，经综合评估选择Mobileye产品EYEQ6-L，最高功能安全可达到ASIL-B，接口资源丰富。 1.Processor According to the requirements of ADAS products, the functional safety of image processing SOC needs to reach ASIL-B. After comprehensive evaluation, Mobileye product EYEQ6-L is selected, and the highest functional safety can reach ASIL-B with abundant interface resources. + 2、时钟 硬件选型30MHz晶振给EYEQ6-L提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。外部20MHz有源晶振作为内部监控时钟。 2.Clock The 30MHz crystal provides clock input to the EYEQ6-L, and its internal PLL circuit completes frequency multiplication and frequency division for the EyeQ6-L core and each module. The external 20MHz active crystal is energized as an internal monitoring clock. 3、DDR EYEQ6在外扩的DDR中运行程序和存储临时数据，其DDR控制器可支持32bits位宽的LPDDR4 SDRAM，最大读写速率4266 Mb/s/pin 。本设计中选用1片32bit的LPDDR4 SDRAM，型号为车规级器件K4F8E3S4HD-GHCL02V，以充分利用数据带宽，保证EYEQ6的处理速度，LPDDR4工作环境温度为-40℃~105℃，单片总容量1GB。 3.DDR EYEQ6 runs programs and stores temporary data in the extended DDR. Its DDR controller supports LPDDR4 SDRAM with 32bits wide and a maximum read/write rate of 4266Mb/s/pin. In this design, a 32bit LPDDR4 SDRAM is selected, the model is car grade device K4F8E3S4HD-GHCLO2V, in order to make full use of the data bandwidth and ensure the processing speed of EYEQ6. The working environment temperature of LPDDR4 is -40℃-105℃, and the total capacity of a single chip is 1GB. 4、NAND FLASH 选择ME推荐的WinBond公司产品W35N02JWTBKF，容量2Gb，FLASH支持CRC安全机制。 NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_ SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_ SPI进行电平转换，通过MCU_SPI1_CS片选电平转换芯片，实现MCU对NAND FLASH的读写操作，转换芯片在本应用场景下支持最大传输速率80Mbps。 NAND FLASH Choose the WinBond company product W35N02JWTBKF recommended by ME, with a capacity of 2Gb and FLASH supporting CRC security mechanism. NXB0104 is used for the level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8_SPI of NAND FLASH. The level conversion chip is selected by MCU_SPI1_CS chip to realize the reading and writing operation of MCU to NAND FLASH. The converter chip supports a maximum transmission rate of 80Mbps in this application scenario. 5、电源和复位 EYEQ6-L需要6路电源：VCC3V3_EQ、VCC0V75、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC1V8_EQ，其中VCC0V75用于给内核供电。复位信号由MCU通过P02.4口进行控制。 Power and reset EYEQ6-L requires six power sources: VCC3V3-EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V8_EQ, where VCCOV75 is used to power the core. The reset signal is controlled by the MCU through the P02.4 pin.

question: 文档声明板上有哪些 CAN 相关模块，回答时能否用网表确认其具体连接？
reference_answer: HSI 硬件架构包含 CAN/CAN FD 电路；具体器件和网络连接应以 EDF 检索结果为准，文档能力声明与网表拓扑需分别标注来源。
response:
可以。知识库中的 HSI 文档（600608964_ADAS_HSI 系列 docx）声明了板上的 CAN 相关模块，且知识库中有一份原理图网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）可用于交叉确认具体连接。以下为两方证据的对照结果。

## 一、文档中声明的 CAN 相关模块

依据 HSI 文档的硬件架构描述（证据 [2]）及电源/唤醒相关章节（证据 [3][21]）：

| 模块标号 | 模块 | 型号 | 文档声明的连接 |
|---|---|---|---|
| [F23] | CAN0 | TCAN1046A | CANH/CANL 与 MCU 相连，经 SPI3 与 MCU 连接，VCC3V3_MCU 供电 |
| [F22] | CAN1 | TCAN1046A | 同上 |
| [F21] | CAN2 | TCAN1046A | 同上 |
| [F20] | CAN3 | TCAN1046A | 同上 |
| [F24] | ETH | DP83TC812R | 通过 VCC3V3_ETH 与上述 4 路 CAN 模块供电网络相关联 |
| [F09] | ETH and CAN power sample2 | — | 对 ETH/CAN 电源进行 ADC 采样监控 |
| — | CAN 唤醒（平台预留） | — | HM ID F01/F07/F25/F28/F31，三种唤醒方式之一 |
| — | CAN 收发器供电 | LP87702 PMIC | VCC50 专用于 CAN 收发器供电（HM ID F13，证据 [21]） |

## 二、网表确认的具体连接（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF）

**1. 四路 CAN 总线差分网络（CANxH/CANxL）全部在网表中得到确认**，且均经共模电感（L）、ESD 二极管（D）、滤波电容（C）、电阻网络后接到主连接器 X1900，并带测试点（TP）：

| 通道 | 高电平网络 CANxH | 低电平网络 CANxL | X1900 引脚 |
|---|---|---|---|
| CAN0 | C1201, D1200.cathode1, L1200.&4, R1209/R1214, TP1206 | C1200, D1200.cathode2, L1200.&3, R1212/R1215, TP1215 | pin 2 / pin 3（证据 [11][12]） |
| CAN1 | C1207, D1201.cathode1, L1201.&4, R1220/R1224, TP1222 | C1206, D1201.cathode2, L1201.&3, R1223/R1225, TP1223 | pin 10 / pin 11（证据 [16][17]） |
| CAN2 | C1301, D1300.cathode1, L1300.&4, R1302/R1306, TP1301 | C1300, D1300.cathode2, L1300.&3, R1305/R1307, TP1303 | pin 4 / pin 12（证据 [23][24]） |
| CAN3 | C1306, D1301.cathode1, L1301.&4, R1311/R1315, TP1307 | C1305, D1301.cathode2, L1301.&3, R1314/R1316, TP1309 | pin 16 / pin 15（证据 [25][26]） |

**2. 控制与监控信号（与文档"SPI3 连接 MCU"的声明吻合）：**
- `CAN0_STB_MCU_SPI3_CS5_P02.8` 网络：连接 R1126、R1228、R1241、TP1217、**U1200.SCSN、U1202.STB、U1203.NSTB**（证据 [15]）——网络名中直接含 MCU SPI3 片选 P02.8，印证文档所述 CAN 经 SPI3 受 MCU 控制。
- `CAN0_INH` 网络：连接 D1203、R1630、TP1219、**U1200.INH、U1203.INH**（证据 [13]）；`CAN1_INH` 连接 D1204、R1629、TP1228、U1204.INH、U1205.INH（证据 [18]）。

HM IDF11/F12/F13/F14/F15/F16/F17/F18/F19/F25/F27
模块功能 Module Function系统使用车载电池12V电压供电，经过EMI电路后输入至电源转换芯片，转换输出系统各模块所需电源。 The system uses 12V voltage power supply from the vehicle battery, which is input to the power conversion chip through the EMI circuit. Then the power conversion chip convert and output the power required by each module of the system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. VCC3V3_MCU to VCC1V25_MCU(ASILB) 3V3转1V25_MCU是使用MCU内置控制器进行控制的BUCK电源，用于MCU的核供电，功能安全需求达到ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 3V3 to 1V25_MCU is a BUCK power supply controlled by MCU built-in controller, which is used for MCU nuclear power supply. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. VCC3V3 to VCC0V75(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC0V75应用于EQ6的内核供电，要求输出电流能力大，现选型TI的电源方案TPS62872。用MCU的P22.0引脚使能芯片，用MCU_SDA_P15.5，MCU_SCL_P15.4引脚I2C通信来设置输出电压和通信。 VCC3V3 to VCC0V75 is applied to the core power supply of EQ6, which requires large output current capacity. The power supply scheme TPS62872 of TI is selected. P22.0 pin of MCU is used to enable the chip, and MCU_SDA_P15.5, MCU_SCL_P15.4 pin I2C communication is used to set the output voltage and communication. VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR(QM(B)) VCC3V3转0V75_MIPI_DDR用于EQ6的IO口供电，现使用矽力杰的SA23002进行设计。用MCU的P22.1引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR for EQ6 IO port power supply, Silergy’s SA23002 is designed. The P22.1 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3转VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50(QM(B)) VCC1V8用于EQ6、CAM、DDR、FLASH供电，VCC1V1用于EQ6、DDR供电，VCC50用于CAN收发器供电，现选择LP87702 PMIC方案。用MCU的P15.3引脚使能该芯片的5V输出，用MCU_SCL_P15.4，MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C通信来设置1.8V和1.1V输出电压和使能。 VCC1V8 is used for EQ6, CAM, DDR, FLASH power supply, VCC1V1 is used for EQ6, DDR power supply, VCC50 is used for CAN transceiver power supply, LP87702 PMIC scheme is selected. P15.3 pin of MCU is used to enable 5V output of the chip, and MCU_SCL_P15.4, MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C communication is used to set 1.8V and 1.1V output voltage and enable it. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC3V3_EQ用于EQ6的IO和摄像头供电，现使用负载开关进行设计。用MCU的P20.3引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ for EQ6’s IO and camera power supply, now using the load switch is designed. .The P20.3 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_ETH(QM) 3V3转3V3_ETH用于ETH供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P21.0引脚使能该芯片。 3V3 to 3V3_ETH for ETH power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P21.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ(QM(B)) VCC1V8转VCC1V8_EQ用于EQ供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P20.0引脚使能该芯片。 VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ for EQ power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P20.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip.
