HM IDF01/F07/F25/F28/F31
模块功能 Module FunctionADAS产品支持KL15唤醒、CAN唤醒（平台预留）和以太网唤醒（平台预留）三种唤醒方式，当唤醒信号有效时直接使能一级电源，MCU开始工作并启动ADAS产品，并且MCU可以通过MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0信号辅助使能一级电源，实现off delay功能。 ADAS products support KL15 wake up, CAN wake up（Platform reservation），ETH wake up（Platform reservation）, three wake up modes. When the wake up signal is effective, the first-level power supply will be directly enabled. MCU starts to work and start the ADAS product, and the MCU can enable the first-level power supply through the MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0 signal assist to achieve the off delay function.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL15唤醒 KL15 Wake Up KL15分成两路信号： The KL15 signal divides into two signals: 一路经过防反二极管和分压电阻后用于使能一级电源LN10046，当KL15为逻辑高时有效，一级电源开始工作。并且MCU得电启动后会使能MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0引脚，通过防反接二极管辅助使能一级电源并在唤醒源掉电后实现OFF DELAY功能，确保MCU完成所有必要任务之后ADAS产品进入休眠。 One way passes through an anti-reverse diode and two divider resistors , used to enable the EN pin of the primary power supply LN10046, effective when the KL15 is logically high, the primary power supply starts working. The MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0 pin will be enabled after the MCU is powered on, and the primary power supply will be enabled through the anti-reverse diode assist, and the function of OFF DELAY will be performed after the wake source is powered off to ensure that the ADAS product will enter hibernation after the MCU completes all necessary tasks. 另一路通过防反接二极管和100K,1%、10K,1%分压电路，用于MCU的ADC采样进行是否有效判断。 用到的引脚网络是WKUP_ACQ，对应MCU的AN0引脚。 The other way through the anti-reverse diode and 100K,1%, 20K,1% voltage divider circuit, used for MCU ADC sampling to determine whether effective. The pin network used is WKUP_ACQ, which corresponds to the AN0 pin of the MCU. HM IDF01/F02/F05/F10
模块功能 Module Function对EQ6和LPDDR4周边PCB温度进行监控。AOU需求MCU监控EQ6芯片内结温，确保EQ6工作安全。AOU需求EQ6监控CAM的工作温度，要求温度监控功能达到ASIL-B等级，确保EQ6系统的功能安全。 The PCB temperature around EQ6 and LPDDR4 was monitored. AOU requires MCU to monitor the junction temperature inside EQ6 chip to ensure the safety of EQ6. AOU requires EQ6 to monitor the operating temperature of the CAM, and the temperature monitoring function is required to reach ASIL-B level to ensure the functional safety of the EQ6 system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionEQ6温度采样 EQ6-L内部内置了两个温度传感器，并通过外部SPI接口实时发送给MCU，硬件设计可以支持MCU对EQ6结温的监控。 1, EQ6 temperature sampling EQ6-l has two internal temperature sensors, which are sent to the MCU in real time through the external SPI interface. The hardware design can support the MCU to monitor the junction temperature of EQ6. NTC温度采样 硬件设计使用温敏电阻NTC（NCU15XH103F6SRC）采集EQ6/LPDDR4周边环境温度，并通过MCU进行ADC采样和实时监控。NTC温度监控范围：-40~150℃，监控精度±3℃@-40~150℃，MCU的ADC为10bit，即1024个量阶，使得监测精度可以达到3.2mV，电压采集范围0-3.3V。用MCU的AN7引脚采样。 2.NTC temperature sampling In hardware design, the temperature sensor NTC (NCU15XH103F6SRC) is used to collect the ambient temperature of EQ6/LPDDR4, and the ADC sampling and real-time monitoring are carried out by MCU. NTC temperature monitoring range: -40-150℃, monitoring accuracy ±3℃@-40-150℃, MCU ADC is 10bit, that is, 1024 quantity order, so that the monitoring accuracy can reach 3.2mV, voltage acquisition range 0-3.3V. The AN7 pin of the MCU is used for sampling. CAM温度采样 CAM的IMX-728内置了两个温度传感器，温度测量范围是：-40~125℃，温度监控精度为±5℃@-40~125℃。EYEQ6可以通过I2C接口（EQ6L的I2C_0_SCLK和I2C_0_SDA引脚）实时读取IMX-728的工作温度，并进行状态监控和异常诊断。 3.CAM temperature sampling CAM IMX-728 built-in two temperature sensors, temperature measurement range is: -40~125℃, temperature monitoring accuracy of ±5℃@-40~125℃. EYEQ6 can read the operating temperature of the IMX-728 in real time through the I2C interface (I2C_0_SCLK and I2C_0_SDA pins of EQ6L), and perform condition monitoring and anomaly diagnosis.

HM IDF01/F08/F09
模块功能 Module Function系统需求需要板内电源电压进行ADC采样和异常监控，要求功能安全达到ASIL-B等级，确保EQ6系统工作安全。 The system requirements require the on-board power supply voltage for ADC sampling and anomaly monitoring, and the functional safety is required to reach ASIL-B level to ensure the working safety of EQ6 system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionEQ6系统电源电压采样 系统需求需要MCU对LP87702、TPS62872、SA23002、TPS22918和摄像头端的电压VCC3V3_EQ，VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC3V3_CAM，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM进行ADC采样和异常监控。其中VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM电压范围未超量程对电压直接采样。VCC3V3_EQ和VCC3V3_CAM经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_EQ用AN2引脚采样，VCC1V8用AN3引脚采样，VCC1V1用AN4引脚采样，VCC1V8_EQ用AN5引脚采样，VCC3V3_CAM用AN12引脚采样，VCC1V1_CAM用AN13引脚采样，VCC1V8_CAM用AN14引脚采样，VCC0V75_MIPI_DDR用AN18引脚采样，VCC0V75用AN19引脚采样。 EQ6 system power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the voltages VCC3V3_EQ, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC3V3_CAM, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM for the LP87702, TPS62872, SA23002, TPS22918, and camera-side devices. Among these voltages, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM have voltage ranges within the measurement range and are directly sampled. VCC3V3_EQ and VCC3V3_CAM are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_EQ is sampled using AN2, VCC1V8 using AN3, VCC1V1 using AN4, VCC1V8_EQ using AN5, VCC3V3_CAM using AN12, VCC1V1_CAM using AN13, VCC_1V8_CAM using AN14, 0V75_MIPI_DDR using AN18, and VCC0V75 using AN19. CANÐ电源电压采样 系统需求MCU对LP87702、TPS22918的输出电压VCC3V3_ETH，VCC50进行ADC采样和异常监控，VCC3V3_ETH和VCC50经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_ETH用AN8引脚采样，VCC50用AN1引脚采样。 CANÐ power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the output voltages VCC3V3_ETH and VCC50 from the LP87702 and TPS22918. Both VCC3V3_ETH and VCC50 are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_ETH is sampled using AN8, and VCC50 is sampled using AN1.

模块功能 Module Function系统使用车载电池12V电压供电，经过EMI电路后输入至电源转换芯片，转换输出系统各模块所需电源。 The system uses 12V voltage power supply from the vehicle battery, which is input to the power conversion chip through the EMI circuit. Then the power conversion chip convert and output the power required by each module of the system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. VCC3V3_MCU to VCC1V25_MCU(ASILB) 3V3转1V25_MCU是使用MCU内置控制器进行控制的BUCK电源，用于MCU的核供电，功能安全需求达到ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 3V3 to 1V25_MCU is a BUCK power supply controlled by MCU built-in controller, which is used for MCU nuclear power supply. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. VCC3V3 to VCC0V75(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC0V75应用于EQ6的内核供电，要求输出电流能力大，现选型TI的电源方案TPS62872。用MCU的P22.0引脚使能芯片，用MCU_SDA_P15.5，MCU_SCL_P15.4引脚I2C通信来设置输出电压和通信。 VCC3V3 to VCC0V75 is applied to the core power supply of EQ6, which requires large output current capacity. The power supply scheme TPS62872 of TI is selected. P22.0 pin of MCU is used to enable the chip, and MCU_SDA_P15.5, MCU_SCL_P15.4 pin I2C communication is used to set the output voltage and communication. VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR(QM(B)) VCC3V3转0V75_MIPI_DDR用于EQ6的IO口供电，现使用矽力杰的SA23002进行设计。用MCU的P22.1引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR for EQ6 IO port power supply, Silergy’s SA23002 is designed. The P22.1 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3转VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50(QM(B)) VCC1V8用于EQ6、CAM、DDR、FLASH供电，VCC1V1用于EQ6、DDR供电，VCC50用于CAN收发器供电，现选择LP87702 PMIC方案。用MCU的P15.3引脚使能该芯片的5V输出，用MCU_SCL_P15.4，MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C通信来设置1.8V和1.1V输出电压和使能。 VCC1V8 is used for EQ6, CAM, DDR, FLASH power supply, VCC1V1 is used for EQ6, DDR power supply, VCC50 is used for CAN transceiver power supply, LP87702 PMIC scheme is selected. P15.3 pin of MCU is used to enable 5V output of the chip, and MCU_SCL_P15.4, MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C communication is used to set 1.8V and 1.1V output voltage and enable it. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC3V3_EQ用于EQ6的IO和摄像头供电，现使用负载开关进行设计。用MCU的P20.3引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ for EQ6’s IO and camera power supply, now using the load switch is designed. .The P20.3 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_ETH(QM) 3V3转3V3_ETH用于ETH供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P21.0引脚使能该芯片。 3V3 to 3V3_ETH for ETH power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P21.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ(QM(B)) VCC1V8转VCC1V8_EQ用于EQ供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P20.0引脚使能该芯片。 VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ for EQ power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P20.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip.

模块功能 Module Function32位MCU芯片TC377最小系统模块有SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA主控芯片和晶体、硬件配置组成，实现SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA最小硬件系统工作单元，功能安全等级最高可达到ASIL-D，满足应用要求。 32-bit MCU chip TC377 minimum system module has SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA main control chip and crystal, hardware configuration, to achieve SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA minimum hardware system work unit, functional safety level up to ASIL-D, meet the application requirements.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solution处理器 根据ADAS产品需求，综合评估选型为32位MCU芯片SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA， MCU接口资源丰富，功能安全等级最高可达到ASIL-D，满足应用要求。 Processor According to ADAS product requirements, 32-bit MCU chip SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA is selected through comprehensive evaluation, which has rich MCU interface resources and the highest functional safety level can reach ASIL-D to meet application requirements 时钟设计 硬件选型20MHz晶振给MCU提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。 Clock design Hardware selection of clock design 20MHz crystal oscillator provides clock input to MCU, and its internal PLL and other circuits complete frequency doubling and frequency division for its kernel and each module. 复位及watchdog 系统复位及看门狗芯片采用LP87702内部看门狗，喂狗方式为窗口喂狗，当喂狗窗口无有效喂狗次数超过OTP配置时，将触发整个系统复位。 a) 上电时，看门狗芯片对MCU启动过程进行监控，同时对MCU的电源VCC3V3电压进行低压监控，异常时主动复位MCU。 b) 运行过程中由看门狗监控MCU运行状态，当MCU程序跑飞时看门狗超时触发复位信号主动复位MCU。 Reset and watchdog The system reset and watchdog chip adopts LP87702 internal watchdog, and the feeding method is window feeding. When the number of effective dog feeding in the feeding window exceeds the OTP configuration, the whole system reset will be triggered. When powering on, the watchdog chip monitors the start-up process of MCU, and at the same time, it monitors the low voltage voltage of MCU's power supply VCC3V3, and actively resets MCU when abnormal. MCU running status is monitored by watchdog during operation. When MCU program runs, watchdog timeout triggers reset signal and actively reset MCU. 电源需求 MCU需要1路VCC3V3_MCU（精度：3.3V±10%）和1路VCC1V25_MCU（精度：1.2-1.35V）供电。 4. Power demand The MCU needs 1 channel VCC3V3_MCU (accuracy: 3.3V±10%) and 1 channel VCC1V25_MCU (accuracy: 1.2-1.35V) power supply.

HM IDF26
模块功能 Module Function系统需求MCU外置看门狗，用于监控MCU功能异常时进行复位。 The system requires MCU external watchdog, used to monitor MCU function abnormal reset.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solution窗口看门狗喂狗参数由LP87702的OTP文件进行配置，具体参数为：喂狗长周期600ms，窗口为10~30ms，看门狗输出复位信号低电平持续10ms。用MCU的P13.3引脚喂狗。 The window watchdog feeding parameters are configured by the OTP file of LP87702, the specific parameters are: feeding the dog for a long period of 600ms, the window is 10~30ms, and the low level of the watchdog output reset signal lasts for 10ms. Feed the dog with P13.3 pin of the MCU.

HM IDF01/F08/F09
模块功能 Module Function系统需求需要板内电源电压进行ADC采样和异常监控，要求功能安全达到ASIL-B等级，确保EQ6系统工作安全。 The system requirements require the on-board power supply voltage for ADC sampling and anomaly monitoring, and the functional safety is required to reach ASIL-B level to ensure the working safety of EQ6 system.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionEQ6系统电源电压采样 系统需求需要MCU对LP87702、TPS62872、SA23002、TPS22918和摄像头端的电压VCC3V3_EQ，VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC3V3_CAM，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM进行ADC采样和异常监控。其中VCC1V8，VCC1V1，VCC0V75，0V75_MIPI_DDR，VCC_1V8_CAM、VCC1V1_CAM电压范围未超量程对电压直接采样。VCC3V3_EQ和VCC3V3_CAM经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_EQ用AN2引脚采样，VCC1V8用AN3引脚采样，VCC1V1用AN4引脚采样，VCC1V8_EQ用AN5引脚采样，VCC3V3_CAM用AN12引脚采样，VCC1V1_CAM用AN13引脚采样，VCC1V8_CAM用AN14引脚采样，VCC0V75_MIPI_DDR用AN18引脚采样，VCC0V75用AN19引脚采样。 EQ6 system power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the voltages VCC3V3_EQ, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC3V3_CAM, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM for the LP87702, TPS62872, SA23002, TPS22918, and camera-side devices. Among these voltages, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC0V75, 0V75_MIPI_DDR, VCC_1V8_CAM, and VCC1V1_CAM have voltage ranges within the measurement range and are directly sampled. VCC3V3_EQ and VCC3V3_CAM are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_EQ is sampled using AN2, VCC1V8 using AN3, VCC1V1 using AN4, VCC1V8_EQ using AN5, VCC3V3_CAM using AN12, VCC1V1_CAM using AN13, VCC_1V8_CAM using AN14, 0V75_MIPI_DDR using AN18, and VCC0V75 using AN19. CANÐ电源电压采样 系统需求MCU对LP87702、TPS22918的输出电压VCC3V3_ETH，VCC50进行ADC采样和异常监控，VCC3V3_ETH和VCC50经过两个10K 1%精度电阻分压后采样。VCC3V3_ETH用AN8引脚采样，VCC50用AN1引脚采样。 CANÐ power supply voltage sampling The system requirements specify that the MCU must perform ADC sampling and abnormal monitoring on the output voltages VCC3V3_ETH and VCC50 from the LP87702 and TPS22918. Both VCC3V3_ETH and VCC50 are sampled after being divided by two 10K resistors with 1% precision. Specifically, VCC3V3_ETH is sampled using AN8, and VCC50 is sampled using AN1.

Then the power conversion chip convert and output the power required by each module of the system.

模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. VCC3V3_MCU to VCC1V25_MCU(ASILB) 3V3转1V25_MCU是使用MCU内置控制器进行控制的BUCK电源，用于MCU的核供电，功能安全需求达到ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 3V3 to 1V25_MCU is a BUCK power supply controlled by MCU built-in controller, which is used for MCU nuclear power supply. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. The power supply scheme TPS62872 of TI is selected. P22.0 pin of MCU is used to enable the chip, and MCU_SDA_P15.5, MCU_SCL_P15.4 pin I2C communication is used to set the output voltage and communication. VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR(QM(B)) VCC3V3转0V75_MIPI_DDR用于EQ6的IO口供电，现使用矽力杰的SA23002进行设计。用MCU的P22.1引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR for EQ6 IO port power supply, Silergy’s SA23002 is designed. The P22.1 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. P15.3 pin of MCU is used to enable 5V output of the chip, and MCU_SCL_P15.4, MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C communication is used to set 1.8V and 1.1V output voltage and enable it. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC3V3_EQ用于EQ6的IO和摄像头供电，现使用负载开关进行设计。用MCU的P20.3引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ for EQ6’s IO and camera power supply, now using the load switch is designed. .The P20.3 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_ETH(QM) 3V3转3V3_ETH用于ETH供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P21.0引脚使能该芯片。 3V3 to 3V3_ETH for ETH power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P21.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. The P20.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip.

VCC3V3 to VCC0V75(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC0V75应用于EQ6的内核供电，要求输出电流能力大，现选型TI的电源方案TPS62872。用MCU的P22.0引脚使能芯片，用MCU_SDA_P15.5，MCU_SCL_P15.4引脚I2C通信来设置输出电压和通信。 VCC3V3 to VCC0V75 is applied to the core power supply of EQ6, which requires large output current capacity. The power supply scheme TPS62872 of TI is selected. P22.0 pin of MCU is used to enable the chip, and MCU_SDA_P15.5, MCU_SCL_P15.4 pin I2C communication is used to set the output voltage and communication. VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR(QM(B)) VCC3V3转0V75_MIPI_DDR用于EQ6的IO口供电，现使用矽力杰的SA23002进行设计。用MCU的P22.1引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to 0V75_MIPI_DDR for EQ6 IO port power supply, Silergy’s SA23002 is designed. The P22.1 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3转VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50(QM(B)) VCC1V8用于EQ6、CAM、DDR、FLASH供电，VCC1V1用于EQ6、DDR供电，VCC50用于CAN收发器供电，现选择LP87702 PMIC方案。用MCU的P15.3引脚使能该芯片的5V输出，用MCU_SCL_P15.4，MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C通信来设置1.8V和1.1V输出电压和使能。 VCC1V8 is used for EQ6, CAM, DDR, FLASH power supply, VCC1V1 is used for EQ6, DDR power supply, VCC50 is used for CAN transceiver power supply, LP87702 PMIC scheme is selected. P15.3 pin of MCU is used to enable 5V output of the chip, and MCU_SCL_P15.4, MCU_SDA_P15.5 I2C communication is used to set 1.8V and 1.1V output voltage and enable it. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ(QM(B)) VCC3V3转VCC3V3_EQ用于EQ6的IO和摄像头供电，现使用负载开关进行设计。用MCU的P20.3引脚使能该芯片。 VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_EQ for EQ6’s IO and camera power supply, now using the load switch is designed. .The P20.3 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC3V3 to VCC3V3_ETH(QM) 3V3转3V3_ETH用于ETH供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P21.0引脚使能该芯片。 3V3 to 3V3_ETH for ETH power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . The P21.0 pin of the MCU is used to enable the chip. VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ(QM(B)) VCC1V8转VCC1V8_EQ用于EQ供电，现选择负载开关方案。用MCU的P20.0引脚使能该芯片。 VCC1V8 to VCC1V8_EQ for EQ power supply, the load switch scheme is selected. . HM IDF02/F03/F04/F28
模块功能 Module FunctionEYEQ6-L最小系统组成：外部30MHz晶体给EYEQ6-L提供基本时钟输入，外部20MHz有源晶振提供监控时钟，外扩OSPI接口的2Gb NAND FLASH存储程序，外扩1GB的LPDDR4运存。NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_SPI进行电平转换，用于MCU读写NAND FLASH。 EYEQ6-L minimum system components: an external 30MHz crystal provides the basic clock input for EYEQ6-L, an external 20MHz active crystal provides the monitoring clock, an external 2GbNAND FLASH memory program for OSPI interface, and an external 1GB LPDDR4 operation memory. NXB0104 is used for level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8-SPI of NAND FLASH for MCU to read and write NAND FLASH.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solution 1、处理器 根据ADAS产品需求图像处理SOC功能安全需要达到ASIL-B，经综合评估选择Mobileye产品EYEQ6-L，最高功能安全可达到ASIL-B，接口资源丰富。 1.Processor According to the requirements of ADAS products, the functional safety of image processing SOC needs to reach ASIL-B. After comprehensive evaluation, Mobileye product EYEQ6-L is selected, and the highest functional safety can reach ASIL-B with abundant interface resources. + 2、时钟 硬件选型30MHz晶振给EYEQ6-L提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。外部20MHz有源晶振作为内部监控时钟。 2.Clock The 30MHz crystal provides clock input to the EYEQ6-L, and its internal PLL circuit completes frequency multiplication and frequency division for the EyeQ6-L core and each module. The external 20MHz active crystal is energized as an internal monitoring clock. 3、DDR EYEQ6在外扩的DDR中运行程序和存储临时数据，其DDR控制器可支持32bits位宽的LPDDR4 SDRAM，最大读写速率4266 Mb/s/pin 。本设计中选用1片32bit的LPDDR4 SDRAM，型号为车规级器件K4F8E3S4HD-GHCL02V，以充分利用数据带宽，保证EYEQ6的处理速度，LPDDR4工作环境温度为-40℃~105℃，单片总容量1GB。 3.DDR EYEQ6 runs programs and stores temporary data in the extended DDR. Its DDR controller supports LPDDR4 SDRAM with 32bits wide and a maximum read/write rate of 4266Mb/s/pin. In this design, a 32bit LPDDR4 SDRAM is selected, the model is car grade device K4F8E3S4HD-GHCLO2V, in order to make full use of the data bandwidth and ensure the processing speed of EYEQ6. The working environment temperature of LPDDR4 is -40℃-105℃, and the total capacity of a single chip is 1GB. 4、NAND FLASH 选择ME推荐的WinBond公司产品W35N02JWTBKF，容量2Gb，FLASH支持CRC安全机制。 NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_ SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_ SPI进行电平转换，通过MCU_SPI1_CS片选电平转换芯片，实现MCU对NAND FLASH的读写操作，转换芯片在本应用场景下支持最大传输速率80Mbps。 NAND FLASH Choose the WinBond company product W35N02JWTBKF recommended by ME, with a capacity of 2Gb and FLASH supporting CRC security mechanism. NXB0104 is used for the level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8_SPI of NAND FLASH. The level conversion chip is selected by MCU_SPI1_CS chip to realize the reading and writing operation of MCU to NAND FLASH. The converter chip supports a maximum transmission rate of 80Mbps in this application scenario. 5、电源和复位 EYEQ6-L需要6路电源：VCC3V3_EQ、VCC0V75、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC1V8_EQ，其中VCC0V75用于给内核供电。复位信号由MCU通过P02.4口进行控制。 Power and reset EYEQ6-L requires six power sources: VCC3V3-EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V8_EQ, where VCCOV75 is used to power the core. The reset signal is controlled by the MCU through the P02.4 pin.

HM IDF01/F07/F25/F28/F31
模块功能 Module FunctionADAS产品支持KL15唤醒、CAN唤醒（平台预留）和以太网唤醒（平台预留）三种唤醒方式，当唤醒信号有效时直接使能一级电源，MCU开始工作并启动ADAS产品，并且MCU可以通过MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0信号辅助使能一级电源，实现off delay功能。 ADAS products support KL15 wake up, CAN wake up（Platform reservation），ETH wake up（Platform reservation）, three wake up modes. When the wake up signal is effective, the first-level power supply will be directly enabled. MCU starts to work and start the ADAS product, and the MCU can enable the first-level power supply through the MCU_WAKE_HOLD_P12.0 signal assist to achieve the off delay function.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solutionKL15唤醒 KL15 Wake Up KL15分成两路信号： The KL15 signal divides into two signals: 一路经过防反二极管和分压电阻后用于使能一级电源LN10046，当KL15为逻辑高时有效，一级电源开始工作。并且MCU得电启动后会使能MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0引脚，通过防反接二极管辅助使能一级电源并在唤醒源掉电后实现OFF DELAY功能，确保MCU完成所有必要任务之后ADAS产品进入休眠。 One way passes through an anti-reverse diode and two divider resistors , used to enable the EN pin of the primary power supply LN10046, effective when the KL15 is logically high, the primary power supply starts working. The MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0 pin will be enabled after the MCU is powered on, and the primary power supply will be enabled through the anti-reverse diode assist, and the function of OFF DELAY will be performed after the wake source is powered off to ensure that the ADAS product will enter hibernation after the MCU completes all necessary tasks. 另一路通过防反接二极管和100K,1%、10K,1%分压电路，用于MCU的ADC采样进行是否有效判断。 用到的引脚网络是WKUP_ACQ，对应MCU的AN0引脚。 The other way through the anti-reverse diode and 100K,1%, 20K,1% voltage divider circuit, used for MCU ADC sampling to determine whether effective. The pin network used is WKUP_ACQ, which corresponds to the AN0 pin of the MCU. question: VCC3V3 在板上主要给哪些电源器件供电？不要把电阻电容当成主要负载。
reference_answer: VCC3V3 是主要 3.3V 电源轨，供给 U1700、U1800、U1500、U1802、U1804 和 U1600 等 IC；回答应聚焦芯片而非无源器件。
response:
根据电路网表 **825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF** 中 `VCC3V3` 网络的完整连接关系（该网络共连接 50 个引脚），剔除去耦电容（C1500/C1617/C1700/C1800 系列）、电阻、磁珠/电感（L1601、L1701）和测试点（TP1605、TP1803）后，**VCC3V3 的主要供电对象（电源类器件）**如下：

## VCC3V3 主要供电的电源器件

| 位号 | 器件型号（证据可查的） | 在 VCC3V3 上的引脚 | 角色 / 去向 |
|------|----------------------|-------------------|------------|
| **U1600** | 证据中未给出型号 | VCCIN | 电源芯片输入（Power/PMIC 模块成员） |
| **U1700** | 证据中未给出型号 | VIN_B0_1、VIN_B0_2、VIN_B1_1、VIN_B1_2、VANA | 双通道降压 PMIC，I²C 受控（SCL/SDA 与 U1800 共享，由 MCU U900 控制） |
| **U1800** | TPS62872Y1QWRXSRQ1（PQFN-16） | VIN、MODE/SYNC | 降压转换器，SW → L1800，I²C 可调 |
| **U1802** | 证据中未给出型号 | VIN | 降压转换器，VOUT/QOD 输出 **VCC3V3_EQ**（供给 U400-2 的 VDD_RING、Y500 等） |
| **U1804** | SA23002C（SA23002CDFD，PSON-8） | VIN（两脚） | 降压转换器，EN 由 MCU_VCC0V75_MIPI_DDR_EN 控制，输出 0.75V MIPI/DDR 轨 |
| **U1500** | TPS22918（SOT23-6） | VIN | 负载开关，ON 由 MCU_3V3_ETH_EN 控制，VOUT 输出 **VCC3V3_ETH**（再供给 U1501 的 IN/EN） |
| **Q1700** | 证据中未给出型号 | S（源极） | MOSFET 电源开关，漏极输出 **VCC3V3_SW**（经 L1703 供给 U901.S2 等） |
| **X2000** | —（连接器） | 引脚 1、3 | 板间/对外连接器，VCC3V3 引出 |

## 小结

- VCC3V3 在本板上是**二次电源分配母线**：一路直接进 U1600、U1700 两颗 PMIC/电源芯片，另一路分别喂给 U1800、U1802、U1804 三颗降压转换器。
- 此外还通过 **U1500（TPS22918 负载开关）** 派生出 VCC3V3_ETH、通过 **Q1700（MOSFET）** 派生出 VCC3V3_SW，这两个属于电源分配/开关器件，而非终端负载。

## 证据范围说明

- 以上结论基于网表中 `VCC3V3` 网络的引脚级连接关系及 U1500/U1800/U1804 的器件实例信息，型号可靠。
- **U1600、U1700、U1802、Q1700 的具体型号在本次检索证据中未能确认**（resolve_identity 查询未返回型号记录），如需精确型号建议补充 BOM 或器件页面信息后再查。

response:
## 结论：这不是矛盾，而是同一设计的两种 MCU 配置

知识库中的证据显示，**原理图/网表和接口文档描述的是同一套 ADAS 主板设计，只是 MCU 按不同配置（TC367 / TC377）来描述**，且原理图上明确注明了两者可替换。

### 证据梳理

**1. 网表/原理图（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2）——按 TC367 绘制，但预留了 TC377 替换方案**
- 原理图标题为 **SAK-TC367DP-64F300S AA**，页名 `TC367_SYS`（来源：825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.pdf）；
- 图纸上有红字注释：
  - **"MCU为TC367时，此处不贴"**
  - **"MCU可替换为TC377/TC387/TC397，此时这一部分电源需贴，需要接在NC34/NC33引脚"**（即 R924/C930/L903 那部分电源电路）；
- 复位网络命名为 `TC367_RESET_N`。

**2. 接口文档（600608964_ADAS_HSI）——按 TC377 配置编写**
- 明确写明选型为 **SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA**，功能安全等级最高 ASIL-D，章节为"TC377最小系统"；
- 硬件架构框图中 [F01]MCU 标注为 "MCU TC377"，复位信号写作 `TC377_RST_N`。

**3. 文档之间命名本身也有混用**
- HSI 的 ECU-MCU 信号映射表中，复位信号仍写作 `TC367_RESET_N`（G17/PORST 引脚），而另一份 HSI 的框图用 `TC377_RST_N`——说明接口文档内部也未完全统一。

### 建议的处理方式

1. **以实际 BOM/ERP 贴装状态为准**：确认当前项目版本到底贴 TC367 还是 TC377（知识库中没有可查的 BOM 物化表，无法替你确认实际贴装型号，需向硬件/项目组核实）。
2. **若实际贴 TC377**：按接口文档执行即可，但要确认原理图中 NC34/NC33 引脚对应的那部分电源器件**已贴装**（这是原理图红字明确要求的差异点）。
3. **若实际贴 TC367**：接口文档中 TC377 的描述（型号、ASIL 等级表述、部分外设资源）需要按 TC367 校核修订，且 NC34/NC33 处电源器件**不贴**。
4. **统一命名**：建议下一版文档将复位等信号网络名统一（`TC367_RESET_N` vs `TC377_RST_N`），或在文档中明确注明"MCU 位号兼容 TC367/TC377/TC387/TC397，信号名以 XXX 为准"，避免软件、测试、产线（针床/贴片）各按不同叫法理解。
5. **软件侧确认**：HSI 是按 TC377 写的，若实际用 TC367，软件团队需评估两者在存储器、外设资源上的差异是否影响现有配置。

简言之：**两个说法都"对"，对应同一块板子的两种 MCU 贴装配置**；关键是确认当前版本的 BOM 用哪个，并保证 TC377 配置下 NC34/NC33 电源器件贴装、文档命名统一。

The external 20MHz active crystal is energized as an internal monitoring clock. 3、DDR EYEQ6在外扩的DDR中运行程序和存储临时数据，其DDR控制器可支持32bits位宽的LPDDR4 SDRAM，最大读写速率4266 Mb/s/pin 。本设计中选用1片32bit的LPDDR4 SDRAM，型号为车规级器件K4F8E3S4HD-GHCL02V，以充分利用数据带宽，保证EYEQ6的处理速度，LPDDR4工作环境温度为-40℃~105℃，单片总容量1GB。 3.DDR EYEQ6 runs programs and stores temporary data in the extended DDR. Its DDR controller supports LPDDR4 SDRAM with 32bits wide and a maximum read/write rate of 4266Mb/s/pin. In this design, a 32bit LPDDR4 SDRAM is selected, the model is car grade device K4F8E3S4HD-GHCLO2V, in order to make full use of the data bandwidth and ensure the processing speed of EYEQ6. The working environment temperature of LPDDR4 is -40℃-105℃, and the total capacity of a single chip is 1GB. 4、NAND FLASH 选择ME推荐的WinBond公司产品W35N02JWTBKF，容量2Gb，FLASH支持CRC安全机制。 NXB0104是用于MCU的3V3_ SPI和NAND FLASH的1V8_ SPI进行电平转换，通过MCU_SPI1_CS片选电平转换芯片，实现MCU对NAND FLASH的读写操作，转换芯片在本应用场景下支持最大传输速率80Mbps。 NAND FLASH Choose the WinBond company product W35N02JWTBKF recommended by ME, with a capacity of 2Gb and FLASH supporting CRC security mechanism. NXB0104 is used for the level conversion of 3V3_SPI of MCU and 1V8_SPI of NAND FLASH. The level conversion chip is selected by MCU_SPI1_CS chip to realize the reading and writing operation of MCU to NAND FLASH. The converter chip supports a maximum transmission rate of 80Mbps in this application scenario. 5、电源和复位 EYEQ6-L需要6路电源：VCC3V3_EQ、VCC0V75、0V75_MIPI_DDR、VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC1V8_EQ，其中VCC0V75用于给内核供电。复位信号由MCU通过P02.4口进行控制。 Power and reset EYEQ6-L requires six power sources: VCC3V3-EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V8_EQ, where VCCOV75 is used to power the core. The reset signal is controlled by the MCU through the P02.4 pin.

Power off mode MCU controls the power supply VCC3V3_EQ, VCCIV8, VCC1V8_EQ, VCCOV75, OV75_MIPI_DDR and VCC1V1 of EQ6 according to the timing, and the reset signal EYEQ6_RESET_N is configured to low level. Run mode The EQ6 system works and processes CAM image data in real time and sends it to the MCU. Reset mode MCU controls the reset signal EYEQ6_RESET_N configured to low and EQ6 enters the reset state.

question: 忽略无关的摄像头和 CAN 内容，只结合电路与 HSI 说明 LP87702 的供电输出和配置。
reference_answer: LP87702-Q1 是 U1700，输入 VCC3V3，关键输出为 VCC1V1、VCC1V8、VCC50；配置依据 HSI 7.2 节。
response:
以下内容仅基于知识库中的两份资料：HSI 文档（600608964_ADAS_HSI_*.docx，HM ID F13 相关章节）和原理图网表（825504380_ADAS_SCH_TCN2.EDF），不涉及摄像头链路与 CAN 通信本身的细节（VCC50 仅作为供电输出对象提及）。

## 一、器件与方案定位

- **HSI（F13）**：系统选用 **LP87702 PMIC 方案**，将 **VCC3V3** 转换为 **VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50** 三路电源：
  - **VCC1V8**：给 EQ6、CAM、DDR、FLASH 供电；
  - **VCC1V1**：给 EQ6、DDR 供电；
  - **VCC50**：给 CAN 收发器供电（HSI 原文如此，此处仅说明其作为供电输出的用途）。
- **电路（EDF）**：对应实例为 **U1700：LP87702-Q1（型号 LP87702RRHBRQ1，封装 pqfn50p5x5x90-32）**，其 AGND/PAD/PGND_B0_1/PGND_B0_2/PGND_B1_1/PGND_B1_2/PGND_BST 均接 GND 网络。

## 二、供电输出（HSI + 电路交叉印证）

| 输出电源 | HSI 定义用途 | 电路网表证据 |
|---|---|---|
| **VCC1V8** | EQ6、CAM、DDR、FLASH 供电 | 由 U1700 的 **FB_B1** 反馈、经电感 **L1702** 输出；负载包括 U400-2（TC377 的 VDD_RING 系列）、U800-2（DDR 的 VDD1_x）、U502/U503、U1803.VIN（其后级 U1803 输出 VCC1V8_EQ 供 U400-10 的 VDD_MIPI_VPH）等 |
| **VCC1V1** | EQ6、DDR 供电 | 由 U1700 的 **FB_B0** 反馈、经电感 **L1700** 输出；负载包括 U400-2 的 VDD2_x（MCU）、U800-2 的 VDDQ_x/VDD2_x（DDR） |
| **VCC50** | CAN 收发器供电 | 由 U1700 的 **VOUT_BST**（升压输出）直接输出到 VCC50 网络，再经 L1203 分配到 VCC50_CAN（各收发器 VCC） |

补充电路细节：
- VCC1V8、VCC1V1、VCC50 三路均有 **MCU ADC 采集支路**（VCC1V8_CAM_ACQ→U900A.AN14、VCC1V1_CAM_ACQ→U900A.AN13、VCC50_ACQ→U900A.AN1），用于电压监控。
- VCC1V8/VCC1V1 还引出远端反馈网络（VCC1V8_CAM_FB / VCC1V1_CAM_FB，经 R1145/R1144 至连接器 X1903），HSI 中未描述此细节。

## 三、配置与控制接口

HSI 与电路对控制引脚的描述一致的部分：

| 功能 | HSI 描述 | 电路网表（U1700 引脚 → 网络 → MCU 引脚） |
|---|---|---|
| 5V 输出使能 | MCU 的 **P15.3** 引脚使能芯片 5V 输出 | **EN1 → MCU_5V_EN → U900E.P15.3**（R1700、TP1704 同网络） |
| I2C 配置 | 用 **MCU_SCL_P15.4 / MCU_SDA_P15.5** 通过 I2C 设置 1.8V/1.1V 输出电压及使能 | **SCL(EN2) → MCU_SCL_P15.4 → U900E.P15.4**；**SDA(EN3) → MCU_SDA_P15.5 → U900E.P15.5**（上拉 R1007/R1009，测试点 TP1010/TP1007） |
| 看门狗/监控 | HSI 未展开 | 电路中 **WDI → MCU_WDI_P13.3**（喂狗）、**CLKIN(GPO2) → MCU_WD_INH**、**nINT → MCU_nINT_PMIC_P12.1**（中断上报） |

⚠️ **一处不一致需要指出**：HSI 文字称"用 MCU 的 **P12.1** 引脚**复位**该芯片"，但原理图中 P12.1 连接的是 U1700 的 **nINT**（网络名 MCU_nINT_PMIC_P12.1，为中断信号）。HSI 的"复位"说法与网表的 nINT 功能存在出入，建议以原理图为准并与硬件/HSI 作者核实。

## 四、运行模式（HSI，HM ID F13）

LP87702-Q1 定义了四种运行模式，由 **VANA 电压（相对 VANAUVLO）** 和 **NRST 电压阈值** 共同决定：

1. **SHUTDOWN**：NRST 电压低于阈值，器件停止工作。
2. **READ OTP**：VANA 高于 VANAUVLO 且 NRST 高于阈值；电压转换器禁用，参考电平和偏置电路启用，**OTP 配置被加载到寄存器**。
3. **STANDBY**：条件同上；电压转换器仍禁用，但所有寄存器可被主机处理器通过系统串口读写，电压转换器可按需使能输出。
4. **ACTIVE**：VANA 高于 VANAUVLO 且 NRST 高于阈值；**稳压 DC/DC 变换器处于使能状态**，所有寄存器可被 MCU 通过系统串口读写。

即：芯片配置通过 **OTP 加载 + I2C 寄存器读写** 两级完成，输出使能由 EN1（P15.3）和 I2C（P15.4/P15.5）共同控制。

## 五、证据范围与未确认信息

- 以上结论来自 HSI 文档 F13 章节（模块功能/方案/运行模式）与 EDF 网表中 U1700 的实例、引脚网络及 VCC1V8/VCC1V1/VCC50 网络记录。
- **未能从电路检索中确认**的信息：U1700 的 VIN/VANA/NRST 引脚具体接哪个网络（输入电压 VCC3V3 目前仅由 HSI 文字支持）；各路输出的电流规格、上电时序参数、OTP 具体配置内容——知识库检索结果中未包含，如需请补充相应资料（如 LP87702 数据手册或 BOM）。

运行模式 Operation ModeSHUTDOWN、READ OTP、STANDBY、ACTIVE
模式定义 Definition of Operation modeSHUTDOWN NRST电压低于阈值。LP87702-Q1器件停止工作。 READ OTP 电源电压VANA高于VANAUVLO电平，并且NRST电压高于阈值电平。电压转换器被禁用，LP87702-Q1的参考电平和偏置电路被启用。OTP配置被加载到寄存器。 STANDBY 电源电压VANA高于VANAUVLO水平，NRST电压高于阈值水平。电压转换器被禁用，LP87702-Q1的参考电平、控制和偏压电路被启用。所有的寄存器都可以被主机处理器通过系统串口读写。电压转换器可以根据需要进行使能输出。 ACTIVE 电源电压VANA高于VANAUVLO水平，NRST电压高于阈值水平。稳压DC/DC变换器处于使能状态。所有的寄存器都可以被MCU通过系统串口读写。 SHUTDOWN After the enable signal MCU_OV75_MIPI_DDR_EN=L, the secondary power stops the 0V75_MIPI_DDR power supply. READY OTP The supply voltage VANA is above the VANAUVLO level, and the NRST voltage is above the threshold level. The voltage converter is disabled and the reference level and bias circuits of the LP87702-Q1 are enabled. The OTP configuration is loaded into the register. STANDBY The supply voltage VANA is above the VANAUVLO level and the NRST voltage is above the threshold level. The voltage converter is disabled and the reference level, control, and bias circuits of the LP87702-Q1 are enabled. All registers can be read and written by the host processor through the system serial port. The voltage converter can perform enabling output as needed. ACTIVE The supply voltage VANA is above the VANAUVLO level and the NRST voltage is above the threshold level. The regulated DC/DC converter is in the enabled state. All the registers can be read and written by the MCU through the system serial port.

模式状态机 Mode state machine
模式切换条件 Mode switching condition参考： 产品系统需求规格说明 产品系统方案设计说明书 Reference: Product system requirement specification Product system scheme design specification.
备注 Note1、VANAUVLO阈值电压 2、NRST阈值电压

模块方案 Module solution处理器 根据ADAS产品需求，综合评估选型为32位MCU芯片SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA， MCU接口资源丰富，功能安全等级最高可达到ASIL-D，满足应用要求。 Processor According to ADAS product requirements, 32-bit MCU chip SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA is selected through comprehensive evaluation, which has rich MCU interface resources and the highest functional safety level can reach ASIL-D to meet application requirements 时钟设计 硬件选型20MHz晶振给MCU提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。 Clock design Hardware selection of clock design 20MHz crystal oscillator provides clock input to MCU, and its internal PLL and other circuits complete frequency doubling and frequency division for its kernel and each module. 复位及watchdog 系统复位及看门狗芯片采用LP87702内部看门狗，喂狗方式为窗口喂狗，当喂狗窗口无有效喂狗次数超过OTP配置时，将触发整个系统复位。 a) 上电时，看门狗芯片对MCU启动过程进行监控，同时对MCU的电源VCC3V3电压进行低压监控，异常时主动复位MCU。 b) 运行过程中由看门狗监控MCU运行状态，当MCU程序跑飞时看门狗超时触发复位信号主动复位MCU。 Reset and watchdog The system reset and watchdog chip adopts LP87702 internal watchdog, and the feeding method is window feeding. When the number of effective dog feeding in the feeding window exceeds the OTP configuration, the whole system reset will be triggered. When powering on, the watchdog chip monitors the start-up process of MCU, and at the same time, it monitors the low voltage voltage of MCU's power supply VCC3V3, and actively resets MCU when abnormal. MCU running status is monitored by watchdog during operation. When MCU program runs, watchdog timeout triggers reset signal and actively reset MCU. 电源需求 MCU需要1路VCC3V3_MCU（精度：3.3V±10%）和1路VCC1V25_MCU（精度：1.2-1.35V）供电。 4. Power demand The MCU needs 1 channel VCC3V3_MCU (accuracy: 3.3V±10%) and 1 channel VCC1V25_MCU (accuracy: 1.2-1.35V) power supply.

# 从 MCU 使能到以太网 PHY 1.0V 电源的完整路径

## 一、路径总览

```
KL15/唤醒信号 ──► 一级电源 LN10046 (KL30→VCC3V3, ASIL-B)
                        │
                        ▼
                 VCC3V3 / VCC3V3_MCU ──► MCU TC377 得电启动
                        │
                        ▼
        MCU P21.0 引脚输出使能 ──► TPS22918 负载开关
                        │
                        ▼
                  VCC3V3_ETH (3.3V)
                        │
                        ▼
              TPS74501 (LDO，见系统框图) ──► 1.0V ──► PHY DP83TC812R 核心电源
```

## 二、逐级追踪（附证据）

**第 1 级：唤醒 → 一级电源使能 → MCU 得电**
- ADAS 产品支持 KL15 唤醒、CAN 唤醒（预留）和以太网唤醒（预留）。唤醒信号有效时直接使能一级电源 **LN10046**，MCU 开始工作；MCU 得电启动后使能 `MCU_WKUP_HOLD_P12.0` 引脚，通过防反接二极管辅助使能一级电源，实现 OFF DELAY 功能。（HSI 文档 F01/F07/F25/F28/F31 章节）
- KL30 转 VCC3V3 是系统一级 DC-DC，给 MCU 提供 `VCC3V3_MCU` 电源，要求满足 ASIL-B。（HSI 文档 F11~F27 电源电路章节）

**第 2 级：MCU 使能 → VCC3V3_ETH**
- 采用 **TPS22918 负载开关**，将 VCC3V3 系统电源转换为 `VCC3V3_ETH`，提供给 MCU 的 ETH 供电。**由 MCU 的 P21.0 引脚使能该芯片**。（HSI 文档 HM ID F17："3V3转3V3_ETH用于ETH供电，现选择负载开关方案"）
- 系统功能矩阵的电源树清单中也列有 "VCC3V3转VCC3V3_ETH" 这一级。

**第 3 级：VCC3V3_ETH → 1.0V → PHY**
- 原理图 PDF 中的系统框图（BLOCK 页）显示：ETH 100BASE-T1 链路的 PHY 为 **DP83TC812R/DP83TG720R**，其电源链上依次标注了 **"SW TPS22918"** 和 **"SW TPS74501"** 两级电源器件，即 TPS74501 位于 TPS22918 之后、PHY 之前。

- PHY 电源特性：当任何一个电源轨低于 POR 阈值（0.6V）时，PHY 处于断电状态，所有数字 IO 保持高阻态；正常上电后进入正常模式，MDIO 可访问。（HSI 文档 HM ID F24 运行模式定义）

The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. 模块方案 Module solutionKL30 EMI (ASIL-B) KL30供电口处增加EMI电路，用于供电保护和滤波。硬件电路设计在UBD网络增加两个串联ESD电容，PCB布局靠近主连接器引脚处，用于吸收外部ESD信号，后端增加双向TVS管用于瞬态过压保护 The EMI circuit is added at the KL30 power supply port for power supply protection and filtering. The hardware circuit design adds two series ESD capacitors in the UBD network, the PCB layout is close to the main connector pin for absorbing external ESD signals, and the two-way TVS tube is added at the back end for transient overvoltage protection. KL30 to VCC3V3 (ASILB) KL30转VCC3V3是系统一级DC-DC，给MCU提供VCC3V3_MCU电源，所以系统要求其满足ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 KL30 to VCC3V3 is a system primary DC-DC chip, because the MCU needs VCC3V3_MCU power supply, so the system requires it to meet the ASILB to ensure the functional safety of the MCU. VCC3V3_MCU to VCC1V25_MCU(ASILB) 3V3转1V25_MCU是使用MCU内置控制器进行控制的BUCK电源，用于MCU的核供电，功能安全需求达到ASILB，确保MCU功能安全。 3V3 to 1V25_MCU is a BUCK power supply controlled by MCU built-in controller, which is used for MCU nuclear power supply. Functional safety requirements meet ASILB to ensure the functional safety of MCU. 模块功能 Module Function32位MCU芯片TC377最小系统模块有SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA主控芯片和晶体、硬件配置组成，实现SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA最小硬件系统工作单元，功能安全等级最高可达到ASIL-D，满足应用要求。 32-bit MCU chip TC377 minimum system module has SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA main control chip and crystal, hardware configuration, to achieve SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA minimum hardware system work unit, functional safety level up to ASIL-D, meet the application requirements.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solution处理器 根据ADAS产品需求，综合评估选型为32位MCU芯片SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA， MCU接口资源丰富，功能安全等级最高可达到ASIL-D，满足应用要求。 Processor According to ADAS product requirements, 32-bit MCU chip SAK-TC377TP-96F300S AA is selected through comprehensive evaluation, which has rich MCU interface resources and the highest functional safety level can reach ASIL-D to meet application requirements 时钟设计 硬件选型20MHz晶振给MCU提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。 Clock design Hardware selection of clock design 20MHz crystal oscillator provides clock input to MCU, and its internal PLL and other circuits complete frequency doubling and frequency division for its kernel and each module. 复位及watchdog 系统复位及看门狗芯片采用LP87702内部看门狗，喂狗方式为窗口喂狗，当喂狗窗口无有效喂狗次数超过OTP配置时，将触发整个系统复位。 a) 上电时，看门狗芯片对MCU启动过程进行监控，同时对MCU的电源VCC3V3电压进行低压监控，异常时主动复位MCU。 b) 运行过程中由看门狗监控MCU运行状态，当MCU程序跑飞时看门狗超时触发复位信号主动复位MCU。 Reset and watchdog The system reset and watchdog chip adopts LP87702 internal watchdog, and the feeding method is window feeding. When the number of effective dog feeding in the feeding window exceeds the OTP configuration, the whole system reset will be triggered. When powering on, the watchdog chip monitors the start-up process of MCU, and at the same time, it monitors the low voltage voltage of MCU's power supply VCC3V3, and actively resets MCU when abnormal. MCU running status is monitored by watchdog during operation. When MCU program runs, watchdog timeout triggers reset signal and actively reset MCU. 电源需求 MCU需要1路VCC3V3_MCU（精度：3.3V±10%）和1路VCC1V25_MCU（精度：1.2-1.35V）供电。 4. Power demand The MCU needs 1 channel VCC3V3_MCU (accuracy: 3.3V±10%) and 1 channel VCC1V25_MCU (accuracy: 1.2-1.35V) power supply.

模块功能 Module FunctionCamera实现图像采集功能，根据ADAS系统需求，选择图像传感器芯片IMX-728作为camera主芯片。 The Camera realizes image acquisition function. According to the requirements of ADAS system, the image sensor chip IMX-728 is selected as the camera main chip.
模块框图 Module diagram
模块方案 Module solution1、IMX-728芯片 图像传感器芯片IMX-728工作功耗1W，像素8.3M（3840x 2160），最大支持帧数45fps，实际应用帧数是36fps。 IMX-728 The image sensor chip IMX-728 has a power consumption of 0.45W, a pixel of 8.3M(3840x2160), a maximum frame size of 45fps, and a practical frame size of 36fps. 2、时钟和复位 硬件选型25MHz晶振提供时钟输入，由其内部PLL等电路完成倍频、分频，供其内核和各模块使用。IMX-728的复位信号由主板EYEQ6_L通过GPIO_A20进行控制。 Clock and reset Hardware selection 25MHz crystal provides clock input, frequency multiplication and frequency division by its internal PLL and other circuits, for the use of its core and each module. The reset signal of IMX-728 is controlled by EYEQ6_L on the motherboard through GPIO_A20. 3、电源需求 IMX-728需求3路电源：VCC3V3、VCC1V8、VCC1V1，其中VCC1V1由SA23002 DCDC通过3.3V转换输出。VCC1V8和VCC3V3电源由主板进行供电。 Power demand IMX-728requires 3 power supplies: VCC3V3, VCC1V8, VCC1V1, VCC1V1 by SA23002 DCDC through 3.3V conversion output, VCC1V8 and VCC3V3 are spulied by main board.
